Entries.Title: Delightfully Deceitful
Entries.Description: Moo-young has only been taking cases of high-profile clients due to his health condition. But he can no longer suppress the passion in him, so he decides to take the Geumseong murder case. Thanks to him, Ro-um gets exonerated. After being released from prison, Ro-um quickly finds a way to make money using her photographic memory.

Episodes.Title: The Genius Girl
Episodes.Description: Moo-young has only been taking cases of high-profile clients due to his health condition. But he can no longer suppress the passion in him, so he decides to take the Geumseong murder case. Thanks to him, Ro-um gets exonerated. After being released from prison, Ro-um quickly finds a way to make money using her photographic memory.

Episodes.Title: The Jeokmok Kids
Episodes.Description: Moo-young learns that Ro-um was one of the kids sponsored by the Jeokmok Foundation. He learns the history of how Ro-um grew up and why she had to confess that she killed her parents. Meanwhile, Ro-um calls her old friends to carry out the plan she has been planning all her life.

Episodes.Title: Your Values
Episodes.Description: Ro-um catches a man trying to capture her photos and finds out how he's been taking photos of random women secretly. When Moo-young comes to help her, Ro-um suggests unlawful ways to punish him. Meanwhile, Moo-young looks for ways to help Ms. Seo, who lost her son after she gave him up for adoption.

Episodes.Title: Save Ringgo
Episodes.Description: Ro-um uses all the ways to win Myung-hoon's insurance money that is worth 400 million won. Yo-han pays a surprise visit at Moo-young's place, and Moo-young covers up for Ro-um who was hiding there. Meanwhile, Ringgo gets kidnapped by a voice phishing ring, and Ro-um comes up with a way to save Ringgo.

Episodes.Title: The Accomplice
Episodes.Description: After finding out about Jeokmok Kids, Moo-young declares to Ro-um that he'll help with her fraud. The Jeokmok Kids come together as a whole after Nasa joins them. They begin a new operation, and they use Moo-young as their frontman. Ro-um is determined to show him the difference between a con artist and a lawyer.

Episodes.Title: The Arrest
Episodes.Description: Ro-um calls the police on Moo-young, setting him in a trap. But Moo-young quickly thinks of a way to make his way out of the situation. Meanwhile, Ye Chung-sik gets killed in his cell, and the killer names Ro-um as his instigator.

Episodes.Title: The Notebook
Episodes.Description: Ro-um reveals to Moo-young what happened between her and Director An ten years ago. To obtain the notebook containing the identity of the president, Ro-um and her team disguise themselves and break into the hotel vault. Moo-young requests to meet Jang Kyung-ja in person to hack into her phone.

Episodes.Title: The Old Enemy
Episodes.Description: Ro-um and the gang carry out the operation as planned, but a series of unexpected events occur. Yo-han finds out that his mother was an advisor for Jeokmok Foundation and confronts her. Moo-young realizes who was behind his father's company's fraud case that destroyed his family.

Episodes.Title: Truth Behind Jeokmok and Navis Well-being
Episodes.Description: Moo-young calls Prosecutor Ryu and Reporter Woo to help dig into Jeokmok Foundation and Navis Well-being. Ma Kang-soo, the CEO of Darusa International, gets out of prison, which puts Jang Kyung-ja in a pickle. Jae-in learns that the subjects she studied in college were none other than the Jeokmok Kids themselves.

Episodes.Title: The Victims Come Together
Episodes.Description: Moo-young decides to map the whole organization, and Ro-um uses her eidetic memory to recall the contents of the ledger. The Jeokmok Kids join hands with Prosecutor Ryu and Reporter Woo to bring Jeokmok down. Meanwhile, Moo-young hears the news about his father.

Episodes.Title: Who is on Your Side?
Episodes.Description: Ro-um and her team try to get their hands on Kang-soo's plan for his stock price manipulation. Yeon Tae-hoon gets on Kang-soo's nerves and gets fired. Kang-soo demands a copy of the notebook from Kyung-ja. Meanwhile, Moo-young demands Ro-um to tell him why she wants Jay on their team.

Episodes.Title: Delightfully Deceitful
Episodes.Description: Yo-han and Jae-in disguise themselves as a couple and attend Min Kang-yoon's party. Ringgo also attends the party with fake identification, but he fails to capture her attention. Instead, Kang-yoon shows interest in Ro-um. Meanwhile, Kang-soo manages to get the money for his investment, but something unexpected happens at the investment briefing.

Episodes.Title: The President's Identity
Episodes.Description: Da-jung's server gets hacked, and they lose all the data they stole from Navis. The crew thinks it's the president's doing. Moo-young suggests a class action lawsuit, which can have the prosecution search and seize Navis' properties. But this plan doesn't go well, so they decide to commit fraud again.

Episodes.Title: The Last Resolution
Episodes.Description: Moo-young learns what his father did to earn the money for his tuition. Su-ho sees the photo Ringgo sent and realizes who the president is. Ro-um receives a gift from Jay, which leaves her staggered. Then she realizes that the only way to end everything is to get rid of the president herself.

Episodes.Title: The One You Trust
Episodes.Description: Ro-um gets arrested as the prime suspect of Jang Kyung-ja's murder. Moo-young comes up with a plan to get Ro-um out of the prosecutors' office and protect Da-jung, Su-ho, and Ringgo at the same time. Meanwhile, the truth behind Jang Kyung-ja's death gets revealed.

Episodes.Title: The Final Blow
Episodes.Description: Da-jung collects all the evidence against Jay and organizes them so they can be used against him. Ro-um faces Jay head-to-head and demands he return the money he made through Navis. The Jeokmok Kids end up in court pleading guilty to their crimes.

Episodes.Title: Someone I miss

Episodes.Title: A Strong Person
Episodes.Description: After getting drunk at a company dinner, Choi Jun ends up at Lee Jun's house to spend the night.

Episodes.Title: Confused Man
Episodes.Description: Lee Jun starts to work overtime on a project, while an unexpected person shows up at the company.

Episodes.Title: A Man out of Reach
Episodes.Description: Simeon and Lee Jun coincidentally meet up at Lee Jun's company, while Choi Jun tells Lee Jun how he really feels about him.

Episodes.Title: The Approaching man
Episodes.Description: Lee Jun learns the truth about Choi Jun's engagement, while Choi Jun realizes that Team Leader Song also has eyes for Lee Jun.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Confessed his Love
Episodes.Description: Lee Jun feels that Simeon's advertisement doesn't quite fit the brief, so Choi Jun comes up with a plan.

Episodes.Title: The Man I like

Entries.Title: Durian's Affair
Entries.Description: For Do-yi's 70th birthday, her three sons and two daughters-in-law gather at her villa. As usual, Se-mi ignores Do-yi even at her birthday party, and Chi-gang and Deung-myeong try their best to patch things up for them. At the end of the day, Se-mi finally speaks up to Do-yi after all these years, which shocks the whole family.

Episodes.Title: Ri-an Meets Chi-gam
Episodes.Description: Ri-an wakes up at Chi-gam and Eun-seong's home. However, as she sees Chi-gam, she collapses again out of shock. Eun-seong finds it fishy how Ri-an is terrified to see her husband. Meanwhile, Chi-jeong is curious about the strangers staying at Chi-gam's place, so he decides to visit them.

Episodes.Title: Eon Appears in Front of So-jeo
Episodes.Description: So-jeo loses Eon even before she gets to enjoy her newlywed life. So-jeo prays day and night for Eon, and somehow, Ri-an and So-jeo end up at Chi-gam's home in the present. They are confused as they wake up at a different time and space, and Dan family thinks they are mentally ill. Furthermore, Eon appears in front of So-jeo, who is supposed to be dead.

Episodes.Title: Unwelcome Guests
Episodes.Description: Do-yi comes to see Ri-an and So-jeo for herself at Chi-gam's place. Chi-jeong is also curious about those two ladies as they act like they are from Joseon Dynasty. However, Eun-seong is not fond of them as Chi-gam and Chi-jeong are willing to help them when they are complete strangers. Meanwhile, Ri-an from the past finds out the truth behind Dol-soe's death.

Episodes.Title: Ri-an and So-jeo’s Disappearance
Episodes.Description: Chi-gam and Eun-seong experience conflict due to Ri-an’s presence, while Chi-gang becomes gradually upset with Se-mi’s recurring unpredictable behavior. So-jeo tells Ri-an what happened at the water wheel, making them worried that they may return to the past at any moment. One day, both Ri-an and So-jeo disappear from Chi-gam’s house.

Episodes.Title: You Must Leave
Episodes.Description: Ri-an notices Chi-gang resembles her grandfather-in-law in the past. Chi-gam presents a gift he had prepared for Ri-an, triggering a conflict between Chi-gam and Eun-seong. As a result, she decides Ri-a and So-jeo must leave. Meanwhile, drama director Ju-nam runs into Ri-an and So-jeo and becomes intrigued by their unique aura.

Episodes.Title: First Lesson
Episodes.Description: Ri-an and So-jeo are out for a walk when they are asked to perform as extras in a drama, earning them their first paycheck. Chi-jeong hears Ri-an’s voice addressing him as her husband. Ri-an and So-jeo take fingerprint scans for their background check, but the Dan family is shocked at the results.

Episodes.Title: Ri-an and So-jeo’s Identity
Episodes.Description: Everyone rushes to the hospital at the news of Chairwoman Do-yi's car accident. Ri-an remembers Il-soo's shocking confession in the past, and Ri-an and So-jeo undergo hypnosis treatments since their identities are still unknown. Meanwhile, Chi-gam visits the pond where Ri-an and So-jeo had emerged.

Episodes.Title: Ri-an And So-jeo’s Hypnotherapy
Episodes.Description: Ri-an and So-jeo resort to hypnosis for their identity check after other methods fail. During the hypnosis session, they confess their past. The tension between Il-soo and Dol-soe continues to grow, making Ri-an uncomfortable and unsure of what to do. Meanwhile, Chi-jeong witnesses Ri-an experiencing nausea.

Episodes.Title: The Confession
Episodes.Description: Chi-gam witnesses Ri-an exercising for the first time and is overwhelmed with emotions. Do-yi and Chi-jeong are convinced that Ri-an is pregnant. Se-mi encourages Deung-myeong to confess his true feelings to Ayla, and he takes Ayla somewhere after receiving the advice. Meanwhile, Se-mi and Director Ju-nam have a disagreement over Ju-nam’s decision to cast So-jeo as the female lead.

Episodes.Title: Let’s Go Party
Episodes.Description: After being cast in the same drama, So-jeo and Deung-myung develop strange feelings between them. However, Ayla feels uncomfortable seeing them together. Chairwoman Do-yi takes her secretaries' advice and goes clubbing, where she encounters Ju-nam. Meanwhile, Eun-seong feels the housekeeper is acting strangely after the late-night call from her.

Episodes.Title: Another Date
Episodes.Description: After meeting at the club, Do-yi and Ju-nam agree to go on another date. In the past, Lady Kim confesses to Ri-an about Dol-soe. Deung-myung and So-jeo's acting practice kicks off, allowing them to spend more time together. Meanwhile, Eun-seong discovers that Chi-gam went to a cafe with Ri-an, which leads to an argument.

Episodes.Title: What Is Love?
Episodes.Description: Ju-nam and Do-yi go out on a date, enjoying their romantic time and getting to know each other. After discovering Deung-myeong and So-jeo are at the swimming pool, Ayla decides to visit the pool. Meanwhile, the housekeeper, who found the fans at the cottage, rushes somewhere else while Ri-an and So-jeo revisit the pond where they first arrived.

Episodes.Title: Age Means Nothing
Episodes.Description: Eun-seong tells Se-mi she wants Ri-an and So-jeo to return to her house. Meanwhile, Ri-an and Chi-gam spend a wonderful time together at an amusement park after visiting the kimchi factory. However, they run into the housekeeper, who is acting strangely. Do-yi falters at Ju-nam's sudden marriage proposal, and in the end, she tells him her age.

Episodes.Title: Do-yi's Announcement
Episodes.Description: Ayla becomes furious at Deung-myeong for not keeping in touch with her while he enjoys the amusement park with So-jeo and Ri-an. Chi-gam bumps into his old housekeeper at the amusement park, and she tells him he was a servant in his past life. Meanwhile, Do-yi gets the family together after registering her marriage with Ju-nam to inform them about it, and Ri-an finds herself in a situation to move back to Eun-seong's house.

Episodes.Title: The Special Gift
Episodes.Description: Do-yi's marriage announcement stuns everyone, but an even greater surprise awaits as they learn that the groom is Ju-nam. Everyone gathers for Eun-seong's birthday, and the housekeeper offers them a look into their past, starting with Deung-myeong. Chi-gam confesses his emotions to Ri-an after learning about his past. Meanwhile, Ri-an returns to the pond she arrived at on the first night, and Chi-gam becomes aware of it and starts searching for her.

Undeterred, Dan-oh continues her efforts and soon encounters a skilled swordsman whom she believes would be an ideal guest. Along with another guest from Garden of Flowers, the four individuals become involved in an unexpected and dangerous situation.

Entries.Title: Miraculous Brothers
Entries.Description: Fate seems relentless for Dong-ju as he encounters a car accident and learns of his mother's DUI offense, further adding to his hardships. Like many others who reach rock bottom in real life, Dong-ju makes an unwise decision when he accidentally comes across the script of a novel belonging to the victim of his car accident. To his surprise, the novel achieves great success. However, the situation takes a turn when the boy Dong-ju hit finally regains consciousness.

Episodes.Title: A Miraculous Boy
Episodes.Description: Fate seems relentless for Dong-ju as he encounters a car accident and learns of his mother's DUI offense, further adding to his hardships. Like many others who reach rock bottom in real life, Dong-ju makes an unwise decision when he accidentally comes across the script of a novel belonging to the victim of his car accident. To his surprise, the novel achieves great success. However, the situation takes a turn when the boy Dong-ju hit finally regains consciousness.

Episodes.Title: Who or What Am I?
Episodes.Description: Dong-ju's primary concern upon the boy regaining consciousness is whether his old memories have returned. Dong-ju is fully aware of his grave mistake and feels obligated to reveal the truth, regardless of whether he remembers anything or not. Simultaneously, as the murder cases and missing persons investigations progress, the similarities between them intensify, leading to a growing momentum. However, Dong-ju has no idea how this would affect him.

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Past
Episodes.Description: Hyun-soo suggests putting up a banner to look for Kang-san’s family. Kang-san gets discharged from the hospital and decides to stay at Dong-ju’s place. While inspecting the site of the accident, Kang-san sees a boy and follows him. Kang-san finds out that the boy has been abused by his mother. Meanwhile, Hyun-soo visits Dong-ju at his place and asks what motivated him to write the novel.

Episodes.Title: What Happened 27 Years Ago
Episodes.Description: Hyun-soo tells Dong-ju that the murders in his novel are happening in real life. Dong-ju thinks Hyun-soo’s claim is outrageous, but he finds out that she is right. But Dong-ju doesn't report it to the police because he's afraid of losing the luxury he's enjoying. Meanwhile, Byung-man visits Assemblyman Byun and asks about the murder case from 27 years ago.

Episodes.Title: Connecting The Dots
Episodes.Description: Dong-ju visits his old high school’s principal and sees a photo of a man who looks exactly like Ki-jeok. He asks around and finds out that the man in the photo is Lee Kang-san who went missing in 1995 with his brother, Lee Ha-neul. Meanwhile, Ki-jeok tells Dong-ju that his memories are coming back and that he remembers meeting Dong-ju’s father.

Episodes.Title: The Novel That Will Save A Man
Episodes.Description: Dong-ju realizes the connection Ki-jeok has with his dad. No Young-nam kidnaps Assemblyman Byun’s daughter and demands the assemblyman to confess that he tortured him 27 years ago. Assemblyman Byun’s daughter coincidentally passes by Ki-jeok, and Ki-jeok realizes that she needs help. When Dong-ju faces No Young-nam, he asks Dong-ju to save him.

Episodes.Title: The Mysterious Man
Episodes.Description: Dong-ju realizes that the videotape No Myung-nam mentioned could be important evidence, so he looks for it. Ki-jeok visits Woo-jung's cafe and sees the photo of Kang-san, which brings back some of his memories. Meanwhile, during Dong-ju’s book signing event, a mysterious man drops by and leaves him a note.

Episodes.Title: Tell Me The Truth
Episodes.Description: Ki-jeok calls Hyun-soo and asks her to find his family with his real name, Lee Kang-san. He then meets Woo-jung and asks her about his brother. During police interrogation, No Myung-nam has a panic attack and passes out. Meanwhile, Dong-ju finally meets Lee Tae-man and talks about his novel.

Episodes.Title: Candid Conundrum
Episodes.Description: Kang-san persists in probing Dong-ju's awareness of his identity, raising tough questions about when and how he became aware. Although Dong-ju acknowledges his mistakes, he also believes that certain things are best left unspoken. As a result, he resorts to a convenient truth. Meanwhile, Dong-ju is confronted with plagiarism allegations concerning his best-selling novel, and he may have to shoulder the blame alone if things turn against him.

Episodes.Title: A Skeleton At Sopyung Lake
Episodes.Description: The discovery of skeletal remains and a student card with Lee Ha-neul's name at Sopyung Lake marks a significant shift in the investigation. Kang-san is heartbroken, fearing the loss of his brother. Meanwhile, Hye-kyung becomes suspicious of Tae-man's attention towards the boy living with Dong-ju. Acting as if she is unfamiliar with the boy, Hye-kyung accepts Kang-san's picture from Tae-man but immediately visits Dong-ju's house, bringing a mysterious gift.

Episodes.Title: An Ally or a Foe?
Episodes.Description: Dong-joo and Kang-san stumble upon a flash drive inside a gift Hye-kyung left behind after her short visit. The data inside seems significant enough to shake the whole country. The two feel the need to be honest with each other if they are to work together toward the truth. Meanwhile at the station, the flash drive goes missing, and the last person who held on to it was Detective Kim. Kang-san's pursuit of his brother continues.

Episodes.Title: Closing In
Episodes.Description: The police investigation intensifies as they start suspecting Byun Jong-il's involvement in the Jeon Doo-hyun murder case. Simultaneously, No Myung-nam is discovered in an alleged suicide attempt. Meanwhile, Kang-san confides all his secrets to Hyun-soo, who then seeks a favor from him. However, Dong-joo vehemently rejects the idea for Kang-san's well-being. On a hospital bed, Myung-nam remains unconscious, and Kang-san tries to read his troubled state of mind.

Episodes.Title: Byun Jong-il Disappears
Episodes.Description: The discovery of skeletal remains and a student card with Lee Ha-neul's name at Sopyung Lake marks a significant shift in the investigation. Kang San is heartbroken, fearing the loss of his brother. Meanwhile, Hye-kyung becomes suspicious of Tae-man's attention towards the boy living with Dong-ju. Acting as if she is unfamiliar with the boy, Hye-kyung accepts Kang San's picture from Tae-man but immediately visits Dong-ju's house, bringing a mysterious gift.

Episodes.Title: Byun Jong-il Is Dead
Episodes.Description: As the police approach the truth, Lee Tae-man's discomfort grows, causing him to make rushed mistakes. Dong-ju uncovers news of Byun Jong-il's death and holds himself responsible for failing to elicit a confession regarding his father's murder. Meanwhile, Kang San finally meets his brother and comprehends why Ha-neul is adamant about keeping Kang San away. At the same time, Dong-ju has his own agenda to finalize things definitively.

Episodes.Title: The Public's Right to Know
Episodes.Description: Dong Ju drops a bombshell during a TV show, bringing to light all the concealed facts related to Lee Tae-man and others, including his own undisclosed matters. This disclosure causes a shift in the investigation, prompting individuals previously deemed unlikely to cooperate to come forward voluntarily for interrogation by the police. Meanwhile, an individual approaches Kang San with the demeanor of a guilty party, earnestly seeking forgiveness.

Episodes.Title: I'm Sorry
Episodes.Description: Kang San is regretful for losing control and causing harm to Dong-ju. Dong-ju reassures him that he's fine, but he expresses concern about his recent instability. Meanwhile, the police are on the verge of apprehending Lee Tae-man and Choi Jong-nam, but their window of opportunity is closing rapidly. Byung-man pays a visit to Chang-geun, expressing remorse for not giving more attention to the young individual who sought his help 27 years ago.

Entries.Title: Kokdu: Season of Deity
Entries.Description: Things aren't going great for Gye-jeol. She gets fired at the hospital she is doing her fellowship and nearly falls when a mysterious man saves her. She falls for him the minute she lays eyes on him, but then he disappears. The man turns out to be Professor Do Jin-woo of the Pilseong Medical Center, who hires her. However, there is something suspicious about him.

Episodes.Title: The Season of Kokdu Begins
Episodes.Description: Things aren't going great for Gye-jeol. She gets fired at the hospital she is doing her fellowship and nearly falls when a mysterious man saves her. She falls for him the minute she lays eyes on him, but then he disappears. The man turns out to be Professor Do Jin-woo of the Pilseong Medical Center, who hires her. However, there is something suspicious about him.

Episodes.Title: Finally, The Woman Who Can Uncurse Me!
Episodes.Description: Kokdu, the Deity of the Underworld, has possessed Do Jin Woo's body. However, Gye Jeol has no clue where Do Jin Woo has disappeared and begins to face the repercussions. Without knowing Do Jin Woo has become Kokdu, she finally finds him, only to learn that he wants to kill her.

Episodes.Title: Are We Dating?
Episodes.Description: A clue that could help uncurse Kokdu appears. Kokdu tries to change his fate by seducing Gye Jeol. However, it's not as easy as he thinks. His first attempt puts him in the gutters, and he needs a better way to disguise his true colours. Maybe money will do the trick? Or how about a clinic?

Episodes.Title: Did We Meet In Our Previous Lives?
Episodes.Description: Gye Jeol and Kokdu get caught up in a strange, unexplainable car accident with a man who suddenly appears in front of them and then disappears. Meanwhile, Gye Jeol opens her clinic and agrees to date Kokdu. However, will they find their way out through the misunderstandings and secrets and end their date unscathed?

Episodes.Title: Why Is Love So Empty?
Episodes.Description: Kokdu learns that Han Gye Jeol was Seol Hee all along, and he prepares to propose to her. However, unexpected obstacles get in the way, giving Kokdu a difficult time. Meanwhile, Yi Deun calls Gye Jeol in the middle of the night.

Episodes.Title: Professor, Do You Remember Everything?
Episodes.Description: Jung Won doubts Jin Woo regained his memories and tells him to prove it by doing a test with her. They go on a date, and Kokdu does whatever he can to deceive her. Later, Gye Jeol and Kokdu get caught up in a new crisis with a patient needing emergency medical aid.

Episodes.Title: I Have No Intention of Covering for Kokdu
Episodes.Description: Do Jin Woo is back! Kokdu returns to the underworld, where he helplessly watches over Han Gye Jeol and Do Jin Woo. Will he ever get a second chance to return to the human world and break his curse? Meanwhile, Oksin and Gaksin think of a way to get Gye Jeol to wish Kokdu back.

Episodes.Title: Kokdu, Come Back!
Episodes.Description: Kokdu returns! Gye Jeol realizes that she has feeling for Kokdu as she scours the recycling center for Kokdu's desk. Kokdu hears from Gaksin that Gye Jeol cried for his presence, and he makes his move. Meanwhile, Kokdu finds out who has been trying to get the better of them.

Entries.Title: Korea-Khitan War
Entries.Description: Queen Dowager Cheonchu wishes her own son to become the next crown prince. However, Mokjong is not happy with how Kim Chi Yang, the Right Senior Executive, and Queen Dowager are trying to take over his place as he is determined to succeed the throne to King Taejo's descendant. Therefore, Mokjong is about to summon Prince Daeryangwon back to the palace, while Kim Chi Yang and Queen Dowager secretly send assassins to murder him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Queen Dowager Cheonchu wishes her own son to become the next crown prince. However, Mokjong is not happy with how Kim Chi Yang, the Right Senior Executive, and Queen Dowager are trying to take over his place as he is determined to succeed the throne to King Taejo's descendant. Therefore, Mokjong is about to summon Prince Daeryangwon back to the palace, while Kim Chi Yang and Queen Dowager secretly send assassins to murder him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Court Lady Choi threatens Prince Daeryangwon to take the food Queen Dawager has prepared for him. Prince Daeryangwon quickly runs away from the temple and hides himself in Mount Samgak. Court Lady Choi orders the men to burn down the mountain to find him. Meanwhile, Mokjong holds a banquet for his people, and Kim Chi Yang plots a crime for the night.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Kang Jo, Northwest Temporary Government Officer, sets off for Gaegyeong with a crucial mission. However, deep within his thoughts, he grapples with the realization that Goryeo's very existence is at stake if the current state of ruling persists. Meanwhile, in another part of the kingdom, Prince Daeryangwon anxiously awaits assistance from His Majesty. To his surprise, he finds himself confronted with an entirely new chapter of life, carefully orchestrated for him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Caught in the crossfire between those gearing up for war and those working to prevent it, the puppet king, Wang Sun, and Kang Gam Chan form the front line of those seeking to avert conflict. On the opposing side, Kang Jo believes in the inevitability of war and sees it as a chance to eradicate the Khitans. The turning point comes when envoys from Khitan arrive with a message poised to alter the course of history.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The ministers struggle to dissuade the Khitan envoys as Prince Daeryangwon expected. He believes that Khitan is using the Palace Head Secretary's treason to justify the war. Therefore, Prince Daeryangwon summons Kang Jo alone to his chamber at night to get rid of him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description:
Details

The battle between Goryeo and Khitan begins in the middle of the night, and the people of Goryeo shiver with fear. With 400,000 soldiers, Khitan attacks Heunghwajin for seven days straight, but they are unable to destroy the fortress. Therefore, they come up with another strategy. Meanwhile, Prince Daeryangwon visits the temple where people are gathered to pray.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The Emperor of Khitan is infuriated as he loses the first conquest expedition he is leading. He starts advancing south with his army towards Samsuchae to destroy Goryeo's main force. Therefore, even though Officer Yang manages to defeat Khitan soldiers, the main force assumes Heunghwajin has lost the battle as they are trapped. Officer Yang must find a way to send the word.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The spearhead commander of the Khitan army launches an attack and captures Kang Jo. The emperor of Khitan threatens Kang Jo and the captured generals to become vassals of Khitan. Meanwhile, Hyeonjong receives the news that the Goryeo army was defeated, and Deputy Minister Kang advises him not to share the news with the people.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Hyeonjong sends Deputy Minister Kang to Khitan's camp as an envoy to relay his message. However, the commander of Khitan's army does not trust his words and decides to hold him back in their camp. Furthermore, Deputy Mayor Won of Seogyeong Fortress gives up on fighting against Khitan and is about to surrender.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As the Khitans advance southward, Kang Gam Chan urges Wang Sun to consider a strategic withdrawal for a greater purpose. Wang Sun's unwavering loyalty to his people clashes with the stark reality of limited options. With Gaegyeong in the crosshairs, Wang Sun stands on the precipice of a crucial decision.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Kang Gam Chan makes a critical decision to stay back in Gaegyeong, sacrificing himself to create a window for Wang Sun's escape. Despite Kang Gam Chan's noble sacrifice, Wang Sun encounters unforeseen dangers at every step of his journey. Meanwhile, Yang Kyu is devising a plan to reclaim Gwakju, the current base of the Khitan army.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: The realization of the hardships encountered by those south of Gaegyeong leaves Wang Sun with a sense of emptiness. The difficulties they face highlight his shortcomings as a king, evoking a deep sense of disappointment in himself. Meanwhile, Kang Gam Chan finds himself in captivity as he attempts to secretly rendezvous with Xiao Paiya.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: As his people turn against him, Wang Sun bears the weight of shame for not living up to their expectations as their emperor. Entrusting them with his fate, he seeks to ease the suffering of his people. Ha Gong Jin, following Kang Gam Chan’s plans, heads toward the heart of the Khitan army with a diplomatic letter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Upon reaching Gongju, Wang Sun receives a warm welcome from Kim Eun Boo, the governor, and one of his daughters. Wang Sun discerns a hidden agenda in the daughter's intentions but soon recognizes her potential as someone crucial for Goryeo in these challenging times. The Khitan army begins withdrawing from Gaegyeong, prompting Yang Kyu to seize the moment and launch an attack.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Yang Kyu throws himself into the Khitan army to rescue prisoners, fully aware that this might be his last battle. As expected, he and the remnants of his forces find themselves pitted against the Khitan army in overwhelming numbers. Meanwhile, Wang Sun receives news of the Khitan army's retreat and hurries back to Gaegyeong. Witnessing the state of Gaegyeong, he falls to his knees in despair.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: In the face of opposition, Wang Sun remains unwavering in his commitment to overhaul the core issues haunting Goryeo, aiming to fortify the nation and spare his people from the ravages of war. Nevertheless, dissenters argue that certain priorities must be addressed before delving into Wang Sun's proposed changes. Meanwhile, the Khitans are gearing up for another confrontation with Goryeo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: In the face of strong opposition, Wang Sun persists in pursuing his goals, alongside Kim Eun Boo. Kang Gam Chan, while sharing Wang Sun's ultimate objective, disagrees with his approach and goes to great lengths to persuade him otherwise. Eventually, Wang Sun remains unwavering in his convictions and removes Kang Gam Chan from his position. To curb Kim Eun Boo's influence on Wang Sun, Kang Gam Chan implements assertive actions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: The queen consort seeks to punish Kim Eun-bu while the king is away from the palace. But guilt leads Kang Gam-chan to attempt to spare the commander.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: With Kang Gam-chan's help, Wang Sun succeeds in launching reforms. However, the local governance is unhappy, and Kang Gam-chan faces the consequences.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Wang Sun puts his life on the line during an intense confrontation with regional lords to bring about reform in Goryeo's regional domain. With Kang Gam Chan's return to the royal court, Wang Sun secures a reliable ally. Concurrently, the Khitans exert pressure on Wang Sun to fulfill the homage promised during the recent war.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: The Khitans demand that Goryeo cede its territories to prevent another war, turning a tribute issue into a crucial decision for Goryeo. With time running out, conflicting opinions emerge, and amidst this urgency, Kim Eun Boo takes a perilous gamble for a daring escape.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Wang Sun prepares for battle while Kim Eun Boo, risking his life, attempts to provide Wang Sun with updates on the Khitans' situation. Meanwhile, during this critical moment, military officials in Goryeo decide to oppose Wang Sun's orders, insisting on the restoration of their rightful authority. Kang Gam Chan departs for Heunghwajin with the orders issued by Wang Sun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: On the edge of the northeastern border and lacking battlefield expertise, Kang Gam Chan encounters a looming confrontation with the unyielding Jurchens. Meanwhile, Wang Sun overlooks the insubordination displayed by military officials, while the brewing anger and rage inside Kim Hoon and Choi Jil persist.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Amidst Goryeo's financial struggles, Kim Hoon and Choi Jil launch a rebellion, citing the seizure of military officers’ properties as their justification. Wang Sun, lacking sufficient guards for protection, finds himself surrounded by his own forces. Meanwhile, border troops mobilize toward Gaegyeong to aid Wang Sun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Kim Hoon and Choi Jil threaten the lives of Wang Sun's vassals, compelling him to order the soldiers heading to Gaegyeong to retreat. With circumstances turning against Wang Sun, he faces a dilemma, torn between doing what is right and safeguarding his innocent vassals. Meanwhile, Kang Gam Chan and other vassals operate in the shadows, clandestinely searching for the mastermind behind the rebellion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Wang Sun successfully pursues and apprehends Park Jin, but he is constrained by his own lack of authority. He subsequently seeks to persuade Kim Hoon, who is engaged in a dispute with Choi Jil, to quell the uprising. Meanwhile, a second envoy from Khitan returns to Goryeo, demanding that the King of Goryeo pay tribute to prevent hostilities.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: The vassals, having received Wang Sun's directives, ready themselves to suppress the rebels at Seogyeong. Although Wang Sun, accompanied by the rebels, eventually reaches Seogyeong, those expected to execute his commands are conspicuously absent. Nevertheless, there may be an undisclosed scheme underway to prevent Wang Sun from crossing the Yalu River.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Wang Sun eradicates the rebel faction and prepares for war against the Khitans. In 1018, the final and decisive battle between Goryeo and the Khitans draws near. With Kang Gam Chan leading the Goryeo army as its commander, they embark on their journey toward the ultimate confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: The Khitan Army's maneuvers raise suspicion as they actively evade engaging with the Goryeo forces and persistently advance solely southward. Recognizing their strategic intent, Kang Gam Chan advises Wang Sun to consider seeking refuge, but Wang Sun adamantly issues strict orders to defend Gaegyeong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Accompanied by his remaining soldiers, vassals, and the people of Goryeo, Wang Sun ventures beyond the fortress boundaries with the intention of minimizing the suffering of his people. Meanwhile, Kang Gam Chan clashes with the retreating Khitan forces on the plains of Kwiju, marking the onset of the war.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: The culmination of the war sees Goryeo emerging triumphant over the Khitans. Kang Gam Chan's return is a scene of jubilation, with the citizens of Gaegyeong celebrating his victory. Yet, Wang Sun, undeterred by the momentary glory, devises a plan aimed at ensuring enduring tranquility in Goryeo.

Entries.Title: Love to Hate You
Entries.Description: Yeo Mi-ran’s distaste for petty, philandering men grows even stronger. Nam Kang-ho offends his finicky co-star on the set of their drama.

Episodes.Title: Bad Girl
Episodes.Description: Yeo Mi-ran’s distaste for petty, philandering men grows even stronger. Nam Kang-ho offends his finicky co-star on the set of their drama.

Episodes.Title: Bad Boy
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran starts a new job at a previously all-male law firm where she navigates awkward encounters with a top client, an ex-boyfriend and a familiar foe.

Episodes.Title: Nice Guys Get a Pass Bad Boys Have It Coming
Episodes.Description: After catching Kang-ho in what seems like a compromising position, Mi-ran becomes determined to get close to him so she could bring him to justice.

Episodes.Title: You Are Not What I Expected
Episodes.Description: While prepping for the role of his dreams, Kang-ho turns to martial arts enthusiast Mi-ran for help. Oh Se-na, an old flame, re-enters the picture.

Episodes.Title: Love is Just an Experiment, Life is the Real Thing
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran bats away unwanted advances — including a tricky birthday surprise. Kang-ho's reputation is threatened when false dating rumors go public.

Episodes.Title: Femme Fatale vs Homme Fatale
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran and Kang-ho begin a whirlwind — but fake — romance to combat questions surrounding the actor's sexuality. Do Won-jun meets Mi-ran's roommate.

Episodes.Title: Trigonometry: The Love Triangle Edition
Episodes.Description: Feelings start to get a bit too real between Mi-ran and Kang-ho. Despite knowing Kang-ho's apparent relationship status, Oh Se-na tries to win him back.

Episodes.Title: The Way You Change Me
Episodes.Description: When Mi-ran gets hurt, Kang-ho realizes his feelings for her are deeper than he imagined. Won-jun and Shin Na-eun flirt with teaming up — and each other.

Episodes.Title: You Made Me Who I Am
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran and Kang-ho get serious and vulnerable with each other. To get over her crush on Won-jun, Na-eun tells him about her most embarrassing habits.

Episodes.Title: A Passionate Goodbye
Episodes.Description: News of Mi-ran's dating history gets out, making her a social pariah. Will she and Kang-ho give in to pressure and break up, or will love prevail?

Entries.Title: My Lovely Boxer
Entries.Description: Tae-young, an emotionless manager at Sports and Passion, is drawn into a tough situation when his brotherly friend, Hee-won, gets involved in illegal gambling. Tae-young steps in to help, but the culprits refuse to mend the harm caused by Hee-won's inability to meet his obligations legally. To save his life and Hee-won’s, Tae Young must find the vanished legendary boxer, Lee Kwon-sook.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Tae-young, an emotionless manager at Sports and Passion, is drawn into a tough situation when his brotherly friend, Hee-won, gets involved in illegal gambling. Tae-young steps in to help, but the culprits refuse to mend the harm caused by Hee-won's inability to meet his obligations legally. To save his life and Hee-won’s, Tae Young must find the vanished legendary boxer, Lee Kwon-sook.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Tae-young successfully tracks down Kwon-sook, who is now going by Yu-ri. With a tight deadline of three months, he must manage to settle a staggering sum, with the potential aftermath beyond his grasp. Whether Kwon-sook decides to step back into the ring or not holds Tae-young's fate and his very lifeline. Gradually, he starts appearing during Kwon-sook's morning runs, and the sustained annoyance he displays starts to trigger her interest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Tae-young presents an offer to Kwon-sook, assuring her that he can fulfill her desires in a mere three months. Taking time to reflect, Kwon-sook eventually consents to partnering with him. Unfortunately, challenges arise right from the start. Meanwhile, love, an emotion that boxing had prevented Kwon-sook from experiencing, may be making its way to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: In Kwon-sook's world, Jae-min is the exclusive source of her smiles. Conversely, Tae-young perceives Jae-min as a mere disturbance to the plans he and Kwon-sook have carefully crafted. Meanwhile, Soo-yeon assumes the position of Han Ah-reum’s manager. On the day of the match, Kwon-sook sits in the waiting room, trembling as though haunted by an intangible fear.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Tae-yong finds himself in an unforeseen situation when Gweon-suk brings him to her father's restaurant. Tae-young has no intention of revealing his prior encounter with Gweon-suk's father, but circumstances take an unexpected turn. Meanwhile, Tae-young's minor scheme leads to the cancellation of Ah-reum's title defense match, causing Ah-reum to storm into Gweon-suk's gym.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Jae-min is concerned that the training might wear Gweon-suk down, while Tae-young is annoyed that his over-caring might soften Gweon-suk. Meanwhile, Gweon-suk feels somewhat disappointed in Tae-young, who leaves for Seoul right after taking Soo-yeon’s call. Oh-bok presses Tae-young, reminding him of the due date for the interest. Cornered, Tae-young resorts to cheating to arrange a boxing match between Ah-reum and Gweon-suk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The challenge has now become official as Ah-reum has given her agreement, setting the stage for the match between Ah-reum and Gweon-suk. Meanwhile, Jae-min discusses the idea of becoming Gweon-suk's manager. In an unexpected turn, Soo-yeon accidentally spills the beans about Tae-young's plan to take Gweon-suk to the US for boxing, leaving Gweon-suk feeling quite displeased. It's during this moment that he catches wind of the news about Hee-won on TV.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Tae Young remains confined to his room following Hee Won's departure, unwilling to step out. Gweon Suk lends his support to Tae Young during this period of mourning for Hee Won, extending a helping hand to guide him through the tough times. Meanwhile, Reporter Park relentlessly investigates the connection between illicit sports betting and Hee Won, harboring suspicions about Gweon Suk's possible involvement in the matter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Gweon Suk is kept out of harm's way, allowing Tae Young and Reporter Park to begin their quest for Hyun Ki. In the meantime, Gweon Suk's confusion starts to fade after a talk with Ah Reum, yet she still can't comprehend Tae Young's decision to distance himself from her. On Gweon Suk's birthday, the day they planned to go see a baobab tree, Tae Young receives an unexpected call from Oh Bok.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Disappointment sets in for Gweon Suk as she waits alone at the botanical garden, stood up by Tae Young. Meanwhile, Tae Young rushes to his mother's shop after receiving a call from Oh Bok. Later, Tae Young decides to reveal the truth about everything he’s been going through to Ho Joong, expressing his trust in him to take care of Gweon Suk during this trying time.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: During her preparations for the imminent face-off against Ah Reum, Gweon Suk decides to open up to Tae Young, exposing her true feelings. Simultaneously, Tae Young discloses his intention to turn himself in to Young Ae after he resolves the complications. In an unexpected turn of events, Oh Bok, believed to be in custody, approaches Soo Yeon and Gweon Suk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Gweon Suk and Ah Reum clash as the match begins, but Gweon Suk struggles to spot Tae Young amidst the arena's frenzy. The neck-and-neck battle rages on, and Gweon Suk throws herself into the fight, aiming to confront all regrets before making her exit. Meanwhile, Chul Yong discovers the dangerous situation Tae Young has implicated his daughter in, but the revelation might be too little, too late. The intense match continues to captivate the audience.

Entries.Title: The Eighth Sense
Entries.Description: Ji Hyun is a freshman who moves to Seoul and finds himself intrigued by Jae Won, a senior he meets at work. Joining the university surf club, Ji Hyun hopes to catch Jae Won's attention. Will he ride the waves to love or wipe out?

Episodes.Title: The Restaurant
Episodes.Description: Ji Hyun is a freshman who moves to Seoul and finds himself intrigued by Jae Won, a senior he meets at work. Joining the university surf club, Ji Hyun hopes to catch Jae Won's attention. Will he ride the waves to love or wipe out?

Episodes.Title: The Bus
Episodes.Description: On their first surfing trip, Jae Won coaches Ji Hyun, coaxing him out of his shell. But Eun Ji's presence puts Jae Won on edge. Then, a boozy night cements a connection between Jae Won and Ji Hyun.

Episodes.Title: The Subway
Episodes.Description: After a brief moment of connection, Jae Won bolts, leaving Ji Hyun confused. Back on land, Ji Hyun is unsure about his feelings until a chance encounter with Jae Won brings them closer.

Episodes.Title: The Rooftop
Episodes.Description: While collaborating on a project, Eun Ji spots Ji Hyun's growing bond with Jae Won. Visiting Ji Hyun's workplace, she sparks a fight, until he finds solace in Jae Won.

Episodes.Title: The Market
Episodes.Description: Surf club dinner gets messy: Jae Won gets drunk, and Ji Hyun takes him home, where he is faced with his past grief. Only the ocean and Ji Hyun can soothe Jae Won's turmoil.

Episodes.Title: The Ocean
Episodes.Description: Jae Won finds calm with Ji Hyun by his side, as they bare their souls and explore the coast. But as the sky darkens, the waves rise, and Jae Won's past looms, threatening to take Ji Hyun away.

Episodes.Title: The Bar
Episodes.Description: After the surfing club loses university approval, Jae Won lashes out at Tae Hyung. Eun Ji seizes the opportunity to edge closer. Ji Hyun returns to normal life, but can't shake his feelings for Jae Won.

Episodes.Title: The Pavilion
Episodes.Description: Ji Hyun stands up for Jae Won, finding new confidence and security in their bond. Worlds collide, testing his resilience.

Episodes.Title: The River
Episodes.Description: Jae Won seeks counsel from an unlikely source and as his past haunts him, Ji Hyun must help him face it to reconnect.

Episodes.Title: The Club
Episodes.Description: Surf club's celebration heals past wounds, as Ji Hyun and Jae Won embrace their future together with forgiveness and friendship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After Ha Ram tells Yi Jun the reason why he likes him, Yi Jun finally shares his previous negative experiences.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ha Ram and Yi Jun decide to become "date mates," and set up ground rules for their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Yi Jun's proposal is extremely successful, and it attracts a handsome model who wants to participate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Yi Jun's ex, who hurt him deeply in the past, shows up, which makes Yi Jun depressed, and Ha Ram also realizes something is amiss.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ha Ram and Yi Jun are about to end their date mate relationship, will they move on to the next stage together?

Episodes.Description: Do-han has his suspension lifted and gets called to a murder crime scene by Jong-hun. As he arrives at the scene, he encounters the dead body of Song Young-jin, the accomplice to the biggest fraud case of the century, the No Sang-cheon Ponzi scheme case. He also finds traces of No Sang-cheon who had died eight years ago.

Episodes.Title: The Victims
Episodes.Description: As he keeps watch on the suspect Byeong-jun, Do-han suspects that the case is connected with No Sang-cheon's fraud victims' organization. Then comes the second murder, in which the victim reports to the police that No Sang-cheon is trying to kill him. At the scene of the second murder case, Do-han runs into Byeong-jun yet again and reinvestigates the case as a serial murder.

Episodes.Title: The Frauds
Episodes.Description: As Do-han tries to release Byeong-jun having no clear evidence, Byeong-jun suddenly confesses to the murders. Meanwhile, Na-yeon prepares for a press release about the serial murder cases, and Jong-hun hears surprising news from Byeong-jun when he visits him at the Prosecutor's Office.

Episodes.Title: The Pursuers
Episodes.Description: Jong-hun looks into the past BIGS Network investigation files and finds out that the unreleased first murder victim was So-ram. Meanwhile, Na-yeon is prevented from releasing any articles regarding the case, so she reveals to Do-han that the murder victims are dying in the order on Jae-hwang's list.

Episodes.Title: The Shadows
Episodes.Description: Jong-hun, tormented by the impending doom that is written on the list, disappears. Do-han manages to find where the new suspect Jae-hwang had been staying after his release, but encounters Jae-hwang in an unexpected situation.

Episodes.Title: The Decoys
Episodes.Description: Jong-hun says that he was abducted by Jae-hwang, and the case seems to come to a close with suspect Jae-hwang's death. However, as Na-yeon and the victims' group receive another murder message, everything falls into chaos.

Episodes.Title: The Connections
Episodes.Description: After learning of Da-jeong's investment briefing, Do-han makes a visit and witnesses a shocking scene. Meanwhile, Jong-hun vows not to cover up anything any longer and starts to delve into the case. In doing so, he tells Do-han the truth about the night of his abduction.

Episodes.Title: The Truths
