Entries.Title: Maestra: Strings of Truth
Entries.Description: Cha Seeum becomes the new conductor of the Hangang Philharmonic, but her reforms prompt a backlash.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Cha Seeum becomes the new conductor of the Hangang Philharmonic, but her reforms prompt a backlash.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Cha Seeum must confront her past when a familiar face returns as the orchestra’s new chairman.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Cha Seeum decides to focus on the orchestra. However, crisis looms with rumors of Kim Phil's affair.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Cha Seeum and Kim Phil manage to finish the new song, but a sudden accident causes chaos.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Cha Seeum orders Yoo Jeongjae to keep her secret. The fear of it getting out again torments her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: As Cha Seeum's fear of her illness grows, Bae Junghwa's Remington diagnosis shocks everyone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: After Bae Junghwa's funeral, Cha Seeum subjects the orchestra’s members to a blind test.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Cha Seeum learns that she was Kim Bongju's last call before his death but cannot recall that night.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Detective Choo suspects Seeum in the case of Kim Bongju's death and begins to close in on her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Cha Seeum discovers that her symptoms are caused by poison; Cha Seeum learns about Yoo Jeongjae's spy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Everyone unites to track down the poisoning culprit; a key clue to their identity is found.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Cha Seeum comes up with an ingenious plan to lure the poisoning culprit out of hiding.

Entries.Title: High Cookie
Entries.Description: The top student in Class S of Jeonghan High School mysteriously dies. Knowing the real cause of death, Min-young struggles to cover up the incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: The top student in Class S of Jeonghan High School mysteriously dies. Knowing the real cause of death, Min-young struggles to cover up the incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Soo-young happens to give the mysterious cookie to someone at work. But this one cookie becomes a threat to the sisters' lives.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: While investigating Yoo-jung's death, a detective notices that the cookie is at the center of the case. Min-young attempts to derail the investigation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: A detective visits Soo-young after discovering the cookie's connection to Min-young. Infuriated by the accusation, Soo-young looks for the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Seong-pil, a consultant at the school, calls Min-young privately and offers to help her. Meanwhile, Soo-young's investigation of the cookie leads her to the school.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: With Seong-pil's help, Min-young tries to get out of the cookie business and turn herself in. However, her plans go awry when she encounters an unexpected person.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Soo-young heads to the school to avenge Min-young and takes Won-ju, a cookie distributor, hostage. The chef doesn't budge, and Ho-soo gets caught up in the fight.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: To save Min-young, Soo-young decides to become an employee of High Cookie. She disguises herself as a transfer student and sells the cookies at Jeonghan High School.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Soo-young's seemingly smooth business faces a crisis as she gets involved with Jin-woo, the chairman's grandson. Is it all a part of Soo-young's operation?

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Through a sweet school life with the cookies, Soo-young often forgets about Min-young. Meanwhile, Seong-pil tries to use Soo-young to find Chef.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Soo-young is confused when she discovers Chef's true identity. In hopes that it's not true, she tries to test him, but Chef falls into Soo-young's trap.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Soo-young learns that Chef can't create an antidote to save Min-young. Despite a momentary setback, Soo-young tries to obtain the antidote in her own way.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Soo-young needs the antidote, and Seong-pil needs the recipe. The two are now in the race to get to Ho-soo first.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Soo-young and Ho-soo hide from Seong-pil. The two start investigating Seong-pil to find out his weakness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Min-young wakes up in an unknown place. Meanwhile, Soo-young negotiates with Seong-pil to find out where Min-young is.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Soo-young goes to the place where Min-young is supposed to be, but she is not there. Meanwhile, Ho-soo and Seong-pil fight for their lives.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Soo-young returns to her ordinary life with Min-young. Before they know it, the sisters' positions are reversed. Soo-young starts to miss the cookie's taste.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Soo-young realizes that she can never go back to her nice life without the recipe. But if she gets the recipe, does that mean she can live the life that she wants?

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: People are now looking for the cookie recipe. Chef asks Soo-young if she's confident enough to handle the recipe.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Chef leaves one last thing for Soo-young. Meanwhile, the school becomes a mess because of the cookies Soo-young made. Will Soo-young be able to handle this and become the next Chef?

Entries.Title: Divorce Attorney Shin
Entries.Description: Lee Seo-jin approaches Shin Sung-han to be her representation in her divorce. Sung-han later meets with a central figure in the case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Lee Seo-jin approaches Shin Sung-han to be her representation in her divorce. Sung-han later meets with a central figure in the case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Determined to win, Sung-han convinces Seo-jin to take her case to trial. Park Ae-ran struggles to contain her mother-in-law's belittlements.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Ae-ran approaches Sung-han for his services. Seo-jin attempts to settle on her next steps post-divorce. Later, Sung-han suffers from visions of the past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Upon learning useful intel, Park Yu-seok schemes to antagonize Sung-han. Jang Hyeong-geun finds himself in a daze after receiving distressing news.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: A new lawyer joins Sung-han's firm — but not without aggravating Sung-han first. Hyeong-geun springs into action after receiving an alarming call.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: A figure from the past pays Sung-han a visit — leaving him rattled. Seo-jin begins consulting clients alone. Hyeong-geun says his final goodbye.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Jin Yeong-ju ups the ante in her war against Sung-han. Seo-jin panics after hearing shocking news about her client — but finds solace nearby.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Sung-han uses an opportunity to bolster one of his cases — but inconsistencies arise. Seo-jin considers returning to her old job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: After a challenging preparation, Sung-han makes an impressive move during trial. Choi Jun makes headway in his client's case — but causes a scene.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Sung-han takes on Ma Geum-hui's case. Seo-jin makes her long-awaited return to radio. Kim So-yeon and Hyeong-geun navigate their budding relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Seo Gi-yeong pleads for help from Sung-han. Sung-han changes his mind about Geum-hui's case. Seo-jin receives good news about her career.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: In an effort to protect Gi-yeong, Sung-han prepares for the final conflict with his in-laws. Meanwhile, Seo-jin contemplates a hard decision.

Entries.Title: Lies Hidden in My Garden
Entries.Description: Ju-ran, a woman with a perfect life in a perfect house, feels anxious about the strange smell from the backyard. Sang-eun, a pregnant woman who suffers from poverty and domestic violence, hears the news of her husband's sudden death.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ju-ran, a woman with a perfect life in a perfect house, feels anxious about the strange smell from the backyard. Sang-eun, a pregnant woman who suffers from poverty and domestic violence, hears the news of her husband's sudden death.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Right before his death, Yun-beom shows up at Ju-ran’s house unannounced and mentions the night-fishing meeting with Jae-ho, and Sang-eun later finds out that Yun-beom was in debt. Meanwhile, Ju-ran ends up discovering fingers buried in the backyard...

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: "Your husband killed my husband." After hearing these shocking words from Sang-eun at Yun-beom’s funeral, Ju-ran begins to find suspicious traces of Jae-ho one by one. Sang-eun finds a picture of Jae-ho and a strange girl together in a mysterious cell phone that Yun-beom hid, and begins to scheme to blackmail Jae-ho for money.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ju-ran goes to see Sang-eun and suggests the two of them find out the truth about Jae-ho together. Meanwhile, Sang-eun gets a call from Jae-ho, and as Ju-ran secretly watches the two meet, she is confused about which of the two to believe...

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The identity of Yun-beom's murderer is finally revealed! While being with Sang-eun, Ju-ran sees a side of Jae-ho that she has never seen, but she decides to protect her family. However, it turns out there is another secret hidden in her house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: With Seung-jae's confession, Ju-ran discovers the truth behind the strange smell and noise, and even Jae-ho's secret. Her entire life is on the brink of collapse. Meanwhile, Sang-eun uncovers a secret hidden in Ju-ran's house on Yun-beom's phone that she has received from the police.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Now that Sang-eun knows about the secret of Ju-ran's family, she blackmails Ju-ran. But Ju-ran gives Sang-eun 200 million won and makes an unexpected proposal…

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun realizes that she fell into Ju-ran and Jae-ho's trap. But when things go awry, Jae-ho threatens both Ju-ran and Sang-eun, and Ju-ran makes a dangerous decision when she sees his true colors.

Episodes.Title: Would you like to start the game?
Episodes.Description: Lee Wan arrives at a video game company, and in the elevator it seems that he meets someone that he used to know.

Episodes.Title: Timing

Episodes.Title: Your Social Media
Episodes.Description: Lee Wan shares his views with his colleagues during a meeting, but indirectly learns of a secret that Shin Ki Tae has been keeping from him.

Episodes.Title: A flying ball and sudden confession
Episodes.Description: Shin Ki Tae accompanies Lee Wan back to their alma mater to collect research materials, and while they're on campus, he reveals to Lee Wan an object full of memories.

Episodes.Title: The Distance between Us
Episodes.Description: When Shin Ki Tae sees Lee Wan working overtime, he decides to invite him over for a sleepover.

Episodes.Title: Promise to never be apart
Episodes.Description: Shin Ki Tae and Lee Wan finally go out on their first date together!

Episodes.Title: Crossroads of choice
Episodes.Description: Shin Ki tae accidentally heard Lee Wan reveal his secret, and because of this he feels deeply sad and concerned.

Episodes.Title: The ending of the game
Episodes.Description: A potential new job offer keeps plaguing Lee Wan, so what will his final decision be?

Entries.Title: Moon in the Day
Entries.Description: Jun-o is the top star who is loved as the Nation's Boyfriend. To cover up his scandal, he shoots a public advertisement with the firefighters. At the set, he meets Firefighter Young-hwa who is committed to her job. An accident occurs during the break, and a mysterious being that has been following Young-hwa goes into Jun-o. And this being has only one goal, killing Young-hwa.

Episodes.Title: Young-hwa Saves Jun-o
Episodes.Description: Jun-o is the top star who is loved as the Nation's Boyfriend. To cover up his scandal, he shoots a public advertisement with the firefighters. At the set, he meets Firefighter Young-hwa who is committed to her job. An accident occurs during the break, and a mysterious being that has been following Young-hwa goes into Jun-o. And this being has only one goal, killing Young-hwa.

Episodes.Title: What Is It That Protects You?
Episodes.Description: As soon as Jun-o gets up, he goes to Young-hwa and tries to kill her. However, he fails to do so because of a mysterious shield that protects her. To get past the protection and seek the chance to kill her, he decides to get close to her. Young-hwa finds Jun-o odd, but she tries to understand him, thinking he’s suffering the trauma from the accident.

Episodes.Title: Young-hwa Saves Jun-o
Episodes.Description: Jun-o and Young-hwa are kidnapped by a bunch of thugs. Jun-o beats them up while Young-hwa is unconscious. Young-hwa doesn’t remember what happened, but she gets suspended for being involved in a violent incident. Jun-o asks Min-o to make Young-hwa his bodyguard so that they can stay close. Meanwhile, Young-hwa gets hit by a car and starts dreaming again.

Episodes.Title: Young-hwa's Dream
Episodes.Description: Young-hwa is hospitalized and has a dream about her previous life. Do-ha lets Han Ri-ta stay at his place as a maid. Ri-ta realizes that Do-ha has been feeling guilty about the lives he took during the war. Finally, Young-hwa wakes up, and it seems like she remembers her dream this time. Jun-o gets confused and becomes hesitant about killing Young-hwa.

Episodes.Title: Paths Cross
Episodes.Description: Min-o asks Young-hwa to stay by Jun-o's side around the clock for safety. So Ri-bu and his aides suspect Han Ri-ta's true motives, as they find out her identity. Young-hwa is further assured of seeing Jun-o in her dreams and tries to make sense of his familiarity. Meanwhile, Monk Hae In goes to Jun-o’s company to meet Young-hwa.

Episodes.Title: Their Past
Episodes.Description: Because of the talisman, Do-ha gets separated from Jun-o’s body and reveals himself to Young-hwa. From Young-hwa’s reaction, Jun-o notices that she sees their past in her dreams. Young-hwa doesn’t know what she’s going through, and she goes to see the monk who put the talisman on Jun-o. Meanwhile, Jun-o tells Young-hwa about their previous life.

Episodes.Title: Jun-o’s Identity
Episodes.Description: Young-hwa is startled as Jun-o is well-informed about her past and takes him for a stalker. Jun-o tells her that her dreams are not mere hallucinations, and they are telling their story from 1,500 years ago. Meanwhile, Chul-hwan comes to the company to meet Min-o.

Episodes.Title: Suspicion
Episodes.Description: Young-hwa decides to help Jun-o by telling about the dreams she has. However, it’s not easy to have a dream every day. Tae-ju’s dead body is found near a river, and his will is sent to the police station. Meanwhile, Chul-hwan tells Min-o about Jun-o’s condition. Min-o doesn’t believe him at first, but Chul-hwan tells him there was a way to save Jun-o.

Episodes.Title: The Breakup Trip
Episodes.Description: Chul-hwan tells Min-o that the evil spirit was created because of Young-hwa when she committed a sin in her previous life. Min-o asks Young-hwa to take Jun-o on a breakup trip, so that he could use the chance to get his brother back. Meanwhile, Na-yeon finds out that Jun-o is a ghost.

Episodes.Title: The Fate You Can’t Change
Episodes.Description: Min-o reveals his true intention and pushes Young-hwa off a cliff to save his brother. Jun-o manages to save Young-hwa and learns that Min-o was behind it. Min-o finally realizes what Chul-hwan was after all this time. Meanwhile, Young-hwa finds out that she’ll die young because of the curse.

Episodes.Title: Who is Chul-hwan?
Episodes.Description: Young-hwa is confused as Chul-hwan tells her that the curse started because of her. She tells Jun-o about Chul-hwan, but Jun-o also doesn’t have a clue. In her dream, Young-hwa finally finds out how Do-ha died, and why she had to kill him. Meanwhile, Chul-hwan meets Yi-seul who has been kicked out of her agency.

Episodes.Title: Jun-o meets Chul-hwan
Episodes.Description: Young-hwa knows everything now, and she tells Jun-o why she had to kill him in the past. She wants to leave him saying they shouldn’t be together, but Jun-o tells her how he feels and asks her to stay. Meanwhile, Yi-seul suddenly appears and tries to kill Young-hwa. Her attempt fails, but Na-yeon gets hurt instead of Young-hwa. Young-hwa feels sorry for the people who got hurt because of her.

Episodes.Title: The Obsession
Episodes.Description: Young-hwa and Jun-o tell their friends everything and ask them for help. Jun-o tries to find a way to stop So Ri-bu and end the curse. Chul-hwan tricks Young-hwa to come to the hospital where Min-o is hospitalized. He threatens her with Min-o’s life, but she uses her amulet to stop him. Jun-o arrives just in time to save her, and Chul-hwan tells Jun-o everything about the curse.

Episodes.Title: Just Live Your Life
Episodes.Description: Chul Hwan finds Young Hwa and Jun O who have been hiding in a secret cabin with their friends. Min O appears just in time with the amulet, but Chul Hwan defeats him and finally gets a chance to kill Young Hwa. However, Jun O stops him, and Chul Hwan disappears. And since Jun O has completed his mission, saving Young Hwa, he disappears as well.

Entries.Title: A Time Called You
Entries.Description: Han Jun-hee continues to grieve Koo Yeon-jun. When she receives mysterious flowers on her birthday, she has an odd feeling that her late lover may be nearby.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Han Jun-hee continues to grieve Koo Yeon-jun. When she receives mysterious flowers on her birthday, she has an odd feeling that her late lover may be nearby.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: While investigating her lookalike, Jun-hee receives a strange package. Kwon Min-ju develops a friendship with her crush but soon faces a huge letdown.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jun-hee tries to make sense of Min-ju's recollections that get jumbled up with her own. Nam Si-heon discovers a new side to Min-ju.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: As Jun-hee struggles to distinguish reality from her dreams, she receives an old diary that contains a shocking truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Back in 1998, Jun-hee's bubbly personality shines through Min-ju. Those around her begin to notice — including a mysterious figure who watches from afar.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Si-heon finds himself attracted to the new Min-ju. The love triangle grows when he decides to come clean to Jung In-gyu.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Jun-hee tries to warn the boys of the approaching danger. Meanwhile, a horrifying event takes place at school during the night.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Yeon-jun eventually finds his way to Jun-hee. He does whatever he can to enchant her, but falling in love is not as easy as it seems.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Jun-hee and Yeon-jun enjoy a stretch of happiness. Meanwhile, Si-heon deals with one obstacle after another.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Jun-hee vows to change the past and save Min-ju. Si-heon, while investigating the murder, stumbles upon a chilling truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Min-ju turns a blind eye to the dangers ahead and focuses on spending time with Si-heon. Si-heon and In-gyu, however, start to grow suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: As Min-ju takes her life into her own hands, Jun-hee makes a last-ditch effort. She and Si-heon later decide to finally make things right.

Entries.Title: All That We Loved
Entries.Description: Ko You and Ko Jun-hee are besties at Hara High School. Although they have the same surname and are both handsome, they are different in everything else. Their school life changes as a pretty transfer student comes to Hara High. They fall in love with So-yeon instantly and the love triangle between the three begins.

Episodes.Title: First Love
Episodes.Description: Ko You and Ko Jun-hee are besties at Hara High School. Although they have the same surname and are both handsome, they are different in everything else. Their school life changes as a pretty transfer student comes to Hara High. They fall in love with So-yeon instantly and the love triangle between the three begins.

Episodes.Title: Things That Drove Us Crazy
Episodes.Description: The three musketeers go on a journey to find a store where they can buy alcohol. Strangely, they keep running into So-yeon, the new girl, outside the school, and it bothers both You and Jun-hee. Meanwhile, Jun-hee's dizziness gets worse each day, and You tries to get closer to So-yeon.

Episodes.Title: Hope Brings Real Hope
Episodes.Description: Joon-hee is taken to the hospital after he gets beaten up. However, something other than his wounds is found. It turns out he is going through chronic renal failure just like his brother Joon-young. But this time, he has someone looking out for him. Despite Eun-hye's disagreement, Go Yoo firmly decides to donate his kidney to Joon-hee.

Episodes.Title: Liking Someone With All Your Might
Episodes.Description: Go Yoo and So-yeon hang out more often and start to show their feelings for each other. Therefore, Joon-hee feels disappointed and left out. On Sunday night, Go Yoo and his friends are having a secret wine party at school, and he invites So-yeon to join them.

Episodes.Title: A Secret That Only You Didn't Know
Episodes.Description: Subtle air flows between Yoo and Joon-hee due to their feelings for So-yeon. Meanwhile, Joon-hee becomes more confused about the changes happening to his body and mind. Later, Yoo discovers the secret So-yeon has been hiding.

Episodes.Title: Sadness Brings Forth a Strong Will
Episodes.Description: Go Yoo takes a look at So-yeon's bag and finds Grandma Mo's necklace she lost. He immediately gets disappointed in her, but she does not give any explanation. Meanwhile, Joon-hee tries to think, talk, and act like Go Yoo.

Episodes.Title: If We Don't Let Go of Our Hands Even When We Are in Conflict
Episodes.Description: Ever since the transplant, Joon-hee has been acting strangely. He has become more violent and started to act differently. Also, although he says he is looking out for So-yeon as a friend, he is being overprotective. Frustrated by Joon-hee's actions, Yoo aggressively tries to make him come back to his senses.

Episodes.Title: There's No Ending to Friendship
Episodes.Description: Yoo and Joon-hee have a huge fight in front of the whole school and end up in the teacher's office. Meanwhile, Joon-hee's grandmother collapses and gets an emergency operation.

Entries.Title: Between Him and Her
Entries.Description: On their anniversary day, Hyun-sung invites their friends over to make an important announcement. Sung-ok's feelings are hurt when Hyun-sung neglects her.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Can't Leave, The Woman Who Can't Break Up
Episodes.Description: On their anniversary day, Hyun-sung invites their friends over to make an important announcement. Sung-ok's feelings are hurt when Hyun-sung neglects her.

Episodes.Title: Time to Walk Down the Memory Lane
Episodes.Description: Under Eun-jung’s encouragement, Sung-ok agrees to meet Jong-hyun for a drink. Hyun-sung encounters an unexpected figure at the hotel elevator.

Entries.Title: Numbers
Entries.Description: To find out the truth, Ho-woo decides to become an accountant and join Taeil Accounting Firm.

Episodes.Title: A High School Graduate Accountant
Episodes.Description: To find out the truth, Ho-woo decides to become an accountant and join Taeil Accounting Firm.

Episodes.Title: The Ugly Duckling Jang Ho-woo
Episodes.Description: Ho-woo refuses to join Seung-jo's team, while Hyung-woo tells Jang-hyun to add Ho-woo to his audit team.

Episodes.Title: The Proposal
Episodes.Description: Taeil Accounting is in chaos after the disclaimer of opinions is submitted, but Ho-woo comes up with a plan.

Episodes.Title: The Man Behind Every Plan
Episodes.Description: Ho-woo finds out who was really behind the report on Haebit Construction.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Turn Of Events
Episodes.Description: Upon seeing Ji-soo, both Ho-woo and Seung-jo get shocked. They need to find a way to prevent Soma Tech from being sent to bankruptcy court. Eventually, Seung-jo comes up with a way to save Soma Tech, stabbing his father in the back. Meanwhile, VP Ahn Seung-yeon returns to the firm, which disrupts the peace Je-kyun has been maintaining.

Episodes.Title: The Secret Plan
Episodes.Description: Ji-soo proposes Taeil Accounting to sell Cakebean, a dessert franchise. Seung-jo, who didn't want to be part of the sales deal, becomes the project manager after hearing Ji-soo was the client. While carrying out due diligence on Cakebean, Ho-woo learns that they've been cheating on their franchise stores. Meanwhile, Seung-jo looks into HK Private Equity and finds out the danger Ji-soo is putting herself into.

Episodes.Title: The Identity Of AN
Episodes.Description: Ho-woo decides to accept Sang-ah's offer to help. VP Han is furious with Ho-woo for ruining the sales of Cakebean, but he doesn't fire him. While looking into the identity of AN, Ho-woo finds out that VP Ahn Seung-yeon could've been involved in helping Sang Ah Group build up a slush fund.

Episodes.Title: Better Solution For Ilseong Formula
Episodes.Description: Ho-woo is sure that HK Private Equity already have known how much Sang-ah Group would bid since Han Je-kyun is the representative of Sang-ah Construction for the auction. Seung-jo tells Ji-soo that the fund operator of HK Private Equity is his father. Jang-hyun tells Hyung-woo that he can come by whenever he wants to speak his mind.

Episodes.Title: VP Han’s Big Plan
Episodes.Description: Lee Sung-joo finds out Ho-woo's relationship with Haebit Construction. Lee Bo-sung falls for Lee Sung-joo's trick and loses all of his shares.

Episodes.Title: What He Is Capable Of
Episodes.Description: Ho-woo finds out the man behind his parents' death. Jisan Bank ends up acquiring the problematic online loan company. VP Han spreads rumor regarding Jisan Bank's unstable management, causing chaos.

Episodes.Title: Jisan Bank At Risk
Episodes.Description: Jisan Bank is in trouble. To protect Jisan Bank from Je-kyun, Ho-woo, Yeon-ah, and Ji-soo go to see the president of Taeil and tell the truth about Je-kyun. Je-kyun announces a sudden personnel change to Ho-woo. Ji-soo says she will volunteer to be investigated by the prosecution to make Je-kyun take responsibility.

Episodes.Title: Finally Bringing Down Je-kyun
Episodes.Description: Seung-jo and Ho-woo successfully send Je-kyun to prison, but they soon hear that Je-kyun is out on pardon. Learning of Je-kyun’s plans to take over a bank in Korea, they try to protect small to mid-sized banks. Meanwhile, they receive help from an unexpected ally. Later on, everyone finds their lives moving on from the hectic struggles.

Entries.Title: Joseon Attorney: A Morality
Entries.Description: Han-soo settles in Hanyang and opens an attorney's office. Being notorious for his rude attitude, he gets no customers for a long while. One day, a plum wine seller asks him to file a lawsuit against the leader of the biggest guild in Joseon, and the magistrate holds a court for this case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Han-soo settles in Hanyang and opens an attorney's office. Being notorious for his rude attitude, he gets no customers for a long while. One day, a plum wine seller asks him to file a lawsuit against the leader of the biggest guild in Joseon, and the magistrate holds a court for this case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Han-soo tricks Master Jang into standing as a witness for Pyo, a vicious criminal. He makes Master Jang make a false statement and get blamed for Pyo’s crime instead. Princess Yeon-joo decides to help Han-soo punish both Master Jang and Pyo. After seeing what Han-soo is capable of, she decides to use him for her future plans.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Lady Yeon, the wife of Commissioner Park, leaves her home to stay in Sowongak. It turns out that Commissioner Park abused her and intentionally killed her father to take all of his property. She wants to file a divorce suit against her husband, but it's difficult for a woman to do so in Joseon. Then Han-soo steps up to help her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: So-won misunderstands Han-soo's intention and fires him. She finds another attorney to defend Lady Yeon and tries gathering evidence against Commissioner Park. Han-soo also works behind So-won, convincing Myung-wol to testify for Lady Yeon. However, on the day of the trial, no attorney shows up to defend Lady Yeon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After Commissioner Park dies, Han-soo searches his room and finds the jade dragon. Han-soo, Dong-chi, and So-won head to Cheongsan to find out who gave the jade dragon to Commissioner Park. Han-soo learns it was Lady Park's doing, so he heads to her house. However, he witnesses a murder scene when he gets there.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Han-soo comes up with a brilliant idea to save the newlywed bride, Young-sil. He makes the villagers turn against each other and confess. He even successfully calls Ji-seon to Cheongsan so he can report the murder case to the King well. Meanwhile, Yoo Je-se learns about Han-soo and realizes that all the cases he took weren't mere coincidence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: After So-won realizes who Han-soo is, she becomes devastated as he might not forgive her if she tells him the truth behind his parents' death. Han-soo asks Ji-seon to help him find the princess, but Ji-seon gives him a new case instead, which involves Lord Chu and Lord Chu's son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Lord Chu deliberately cancels Lee Bong-sam's trial and does everything in his power to stop Han-soo. Just as when Han-soo was feeling helpless, So-won comes up with a brilliant idea to solve the case. Meanwhile, after Executive Minister Yoo learns about Lord Chu's son's case, he decides to take action.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Han-soo decides to fire So-won and stay away from her so he can keep her away from trouble. He focuses on taking cases that could lead him to the King. However, the King himself visits him and asks him to take a case regarding the new commissioner. Han-soo starts his investigation on Kwon Myung-woo, the new commissioner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Han-soo looks deeper into Lord Kwon's case, and he finds out that a member of the Royal Family is involved in it. That leaves the King no choice but to cancel the new commissioner's appointment. Meanwhile, while trying to protect Han-soo from getting arrested, So-won has no choice but to reveal her true identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Han Soo gets falsely accused of murdering Lord Chu. So Won steps up to be his witness, but Han Soo refuses, feeling betrayed that So Won has been fooling him the entire time. Han Soo gets tortured, and he is forced to make a confession when a group of witnesses burst into the interrogation hall.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Chu Sal comes to Han Soo and asks for his help. He shares how Lord Won Dae Han is trying to take the lands his brother worked hard to cultivate. With Han Soo's help, Chu Sal files a lawsuit against Lord Won. However, he has a slim chance of winning as Lord Won is one of Executive Minister Yoo's men.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Han Soo gets to meet Ji Sun at the bar for middle-class women and widows. Eun Soo is shocked to know that Je Se is the one who caused the death of Han Soo's parents. Grand Queen Dowager visits the merchant house and says the house must disappear so that Princess Yeon Joo would never come back to the house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Han Soo must find ways to save Eun Soo from getting executed, but there is nothing he can do to stop it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Yeon Joo suggests Ji Sun to use their wedding ceremony as a chance to interrogate Executive Minister Yoo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: The King wishes to punish Executive Minister Yoo with a death sentence, but Han Soo offers a different idea.

Entries.Title: Strangers Again
Entries.Description: Oh Ha-ra, a prominent divorce lawyer, suddenly faces two trials: first is the divorce suit by a top star who came with a prenuptial agreement, and the other is the return of her ex-husband Gu Eun-beom... who ran away after cheating on her!

Episodes.Title: Perfect Revenge
Episodes.Description: Oh Ha-ra, a prominent divorce lawyer, suddenly faces two trials: first is the divorce suit by a top star who came with a prenuptial agreement, and the other is the return of her ex-husband Gu Eun-beom... who ran away after cheating on her!

Episodes.Title: Sexual Issues
Episodes.Description: Ha-ra thinks Eun-beom is trying to reconcile by taking her out on a date... but he sets her up for a blind date! Meanwhile in the court, Ha-ra has to deal with a divorce suit regarding marital sexual issues.

Episodes.Title: Battle of Love
Episodes.Description: Ha-ra's heart suddenly wavers because of Jae-gyeom. But this doesn't last long as anger takes over when she sees Eun-beom with Ki Seo-hee! Thinking that Eun-beom's still seeing Seo-hee under the pretext of the custody lawsuit, Ha-ra takes on the other side's defense.

Episodes.Title: Hard Lessons
Episodes.Description: When Eun-beom is on the verge of losing the custody lawsuit because of Ha-ra's hidden card, he reveals that his affair with Seo-hee was all fake. What is the truth behind their divorce?

Episodes.Title: Driving Away
Episodes.Description: Ha-ra starts dating Jae-gyeom. However, after a few days of dating, she gets swept up in a conflict with his mother, which puts her relationship with Jae-gyeom in crisis. Meanwhile, at the office, she gets overwhelmed as she starts to work on a divorce lawsuit caused by a conflict between a woman and her mother-in-law.

Episodes.Title: What Is Love?
Episodes.Description: Eun-beom accidentally finds out a huge secret about Ha-ra's father. As a result, he continuously hovers around Ha-ra and can't decide whether to tell her or not. Meanwhile, Bi-chwi and Si-wook deal with a divorce case caused by personality differences, which puts their secret relationship in danger of being exposed.

Episodes.Title: In the Name of Family
Episodes.Description: Eventually, Ha-ra finds out about her father's secret, which greatly shocks her. Because of this, Eun-beom takes a case on her behalf, and by doing this, Ha-ra suddenly feels some subtle feelings towards him.

Episodes.Title: Love & Hate
Episodes.Description: Realizing that she still in love with Eun-beom, Ha-ra sets up a crazy plan. She starts telling Eun-beom that she loves him and they should get back together and if she gets rejected ten times, she'll get over him completely. Meanwhile, Eun-beom reflects on her complicated relationship with Ha-ra while defending the murder case that deals with complicated love and hate.

Episodes.Title: Think About "DINK"
Episodes.Description: Ha-ra and Eun-beom finally got back together. However, when Ha-ra takes on the divorce suit of her cousin, who lived as a DINK, a serious question arises between them: whether or not to have a child.

Episodes.Title: Power of Love
Episodes.Description: Ha-ra learns the whole story of Eun-beom's younger sister's death and finally understands Eun-beom's fear of raising a child. On top of that, seeing Han-gil endure all kinds of humiliation due to his ex-wife's dispute over animal custody makes Ha-ra think about things.

Episodes.Title: Ill-Fated Breakup
Episodes.Description: Ha-ra and Eun-beom have repeatedly agonized about having a child but eventually broke up due to a minor misunderstanding. Ha-ra decided to take on the divorce proceedings of clients who broke up and reunited several times, just like them.

Episodes.Title: Give Me a Big Hug
Episodes.Description: Eun-beom is tormented by the breakup and eventually decides to leave the office again. Ha-ra tries to understand Eun-beom and helps him when his mother files a lawsuit due to the worsening conflict between them.

Entries.Title: Live Your Own Life
Entries.Description: Even on the day of her promotion to team leader at TS Fitness, Hyo Sim can't find a moment of peace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Even on the day of her promotion to team leader at TS Fitness, Hyo Sim can't find a moment of peace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim is utterly surprised when she encounters a new member at TS Fitness at five in the morning.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Myung Hee pulls off an escape from her captors, and Sook Hyang is alarmed when she gets the news.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Following an unintended collision with Myung Hee, Hyo Do finds himself taking her to Uicheon Villa.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: At TS Fitness, an unexpected happenstance brings together Hyo Sim and the heirs of Taesan Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho eventually ends up injuring himself at the gym by resisting Hyo Sim's training regimen.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho and Tae Min clash while Tae Ho persists in uncovering his grandmother's whereabouts.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Caught between the fights of his parents, Tae Min feels like there's no one he can rely on.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Seeing her mother a bit under the weather for reasons she's keeping to herself has Hyo Sim feeling uneasy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho gets rid of Jun Bum's car, and Jin Soo wants to send Tae Ho to prison.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho quits going to the gym and looks for Myung Hee, and Tae Min asks Hyo Sim out again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim finds out her mother borrowed money from Woo Ju, and Tae Ho gets a call that his grandmother is dead.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: The reality of Myung Hee's funeral overwhelms Tae Ho, leaving him lost in a sea of sorrow.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim has to cater to Tae Ho in the hospital while trying to be a good daughter to Sun Soon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Seriousness escalates for Hyo Jun at the police station, which could possibly hinder his legal career.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim is astounded by the reality that she must secure a loan from Indangsu, yet she has no other option.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Sun Soon gathers her kids and does the thing she does when she feels her life is lonely and meaningless.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho asks Hyo Sim out on a date, but she cannot accept it due to her difficult situation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Since Tae Ho is not willing to give up on Hyo Sim, she hurts him with harsh words.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sung asks Hyo Sim about her relationship with Tae Ho and tells her to quit immediately.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim and her crew go on a three-day workshop to Damyang, and she lets Tae Ho join them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Tae Min also heads over to Damyang where Hyo Sim and Tae Ho are, and Sun Soon calls Hee Ju over to her place.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Sook Hyang gets infuriated after she finds out about Hyo Sim. Tae Ho drives Hyo Sim home and meets Sun Soon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho is eager for Hyo Sim to confirm officially that they are dating, yet Hyo Sim is hesitant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim's sense of pride crumbles completely when she is presented with the cost of selling her soul.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Enveloped by the enchanting snowfall, Hyo Sim and Tae Ho solidify their emotions through a poignant first kiss. Meanwhile, Tae Min acquires details about the car accident from the detective who handled the case. Despite Sook Hyang's insistence, Tae Hee is compelled to move back in, but she ingeniously finds ways to resist her mother's wishes. Tae Ho and Tae Min find themselves in a disagreement over rehiring Hyo Sim as the company model, while Hyo Sim gladly accepts Tae Ho's offer for a new phase in her life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Expressing her desire for independence, Hyo Sim encounters strong resistance from her disapproving mother. Undeterred, she pushes forward with her plans to move out and actively looks for a new home. Despite reluctance, Tae Min proposes to Soo Kyung to ensure Jin Bum's safety, prompting Tae Ho to question his motives. Sun Soon makes a final effort to retain Hyo Sim by rallying neighbors.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Released from the ties of family responsibilities, Hyo Sim relishes the moments in her new home with Tae Ho. Tae Min, reluctantly married to Soo Kyung, is away on a honeymoon. Tae Hee, forced back home by Mr. Yeom, is now in confinement. Changes are imminent at Uicheon Villa with Hyo Sim's move to a new residence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: In the midst of an inescapable situation with Mr. Yeom and his men, Myung Hee grapples with the challenge of finding an exit. Meanwhile, Tae Ho's trip to the supermarket with Hyo Sim unexpectedly brings him face-to-face with So Ra. With Tae Min and Soo Kyung back from their honeymoon, Tae Hee strategically plans her escape during a momentary diversion of attention. Hyo Jun's decision to give up his studies faces staunch opposition from Mi Rim, who refuses to let him throw in the towel. Hyo Sim takes decisive steps toward shaping her future.

Episodes.Title: Fairy Dancing
Episodes.Description: After seeing Tae Ho collapse, Hyo Sim consoles him. She asks him why he is so sad, but Tae Ho laughs it over. After spending a honeymoon practically separately, Tae Min and Soo Kyung begin their marriage, which is only for show. Hyo Do and Tae Hee register their marriage, and Hee Ju goes to Sun Soon's house but gets put to work. Meanwhile, Tae Ho plans to make Taesan Group the company it once was.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: After a delightful date, Hyo Sim and Tae Ho return to Hyo Sim's house. However, Sun Soon, who had grilled Hyo Sim's address out of Hyo Sung, barges in and creates a scene. Meanwhile, Soo Kyung offers to help Tae Min with his promotion by using the power of the press to disturb Tae Ho, while Tae Hee returns home with Hyo Do, and Tae Ho takes Hyo Sim by her hand to see her mother, Sun Soon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim has had enough of how her mom treats Tae Ho, and she finally lets out her frustration. She even throws some harsh words at Sun Soon, who ends up showing a lot of disappointment. Tae Min learns about Tae Ho digging deeper into the Daegwallyeong Pass incident through Soo Kyung, who isn't happy with how Tae Min is treating her. Meanwhile, Tae Ho takes Hyo Sim to where his parents are laid to rest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: So, Tae Ho straight-up asks Tae Min if he's got the lowdown on what really went down with their old man's death. Things get heated, and they end up throwing punches. Later, Tae Ho crashes at Hyo Sim's pad, asking if he can crash there for the night. On the flip side, Tae Min is hustling hard to secure the top spot at Taesan Group, and he leaves Soo Kyung with scars while doing so. Meanwhile, Hyo Sim and Tae Ho are all lovey-dovey in a parking lot, clueless that they've got an audience.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho and Myung Hee finally meet and shed tears of joy. Myung Hee tells Tae Ho to keep her a secret. With the money Hyo Sim gave her, Sun Soon takes over a cafe. Although Tae Min gets promoted to vice chairman, Tae Ho plans to stop him from becoming the chairman. Meanwhile, Tae Min and Soo Kyung's marriage shatters, and rumors at TS Fitness begin to spread.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim tells her boss she is quitting TS Fitness after he interrogates her about her relationship with Tae Ho. Tae Ho senses something isn't right with Hyo Sim and rushes to her house. However, he runs into Hyo Sung as he is leaving her place. Meanwhile, Myung Hee offers the chairman of TV Live a proposal, and Sook Hyang sets Tae Ho in a trap when things look dire between Tae Min and Soo Kyung.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: As Tae Ho falls into Sook Hyang's trap and gets taken away by the police, he asks Hyo Sung to look after Hyo Sim. Hyo Sim is shocked at the news, and she lets Tae Min know how horrible she feels when he comes to her about what happened with Soo Kyung. On the opening day of Sun Soon's cafe, Hyo Jun, who couldn't get over Mi Rim, shows up drunk and makes a mess. Meanwhile, Hyo Do meets with Tae Min, wanting to strike it rich, and tells him about Tae Hee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho's imprisonment exposes a distinct purpose, leading to Tae Min's interrogation visit. Despite Tae Min's inquiries, Tae Ho remains unwilling to provide any answers, causing frustration for Tae Min. Myung Hee starts disclosing Sook Hyang's heinous deeds on TV Live, leaving Sook Hyang uneasy. Hyo Sung, who dedicated his life to his job, faces termination. Thanks to Hyo Sung, Hyo Sim reconnects with Tae Ho and learns about Tae Ho's grandmother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: Tae Min and Myung Hee sit face-to-face, where Myung Hee ensures Tae Min's steadfast commitment to safeguarding Taesan Group. Recently released from prison, Tae Ho declares a management war against Sook Hyang and Jin Bum. Hyo Sim, spotting Tae Ho waiting for her outside her house, joyfully runs into his arms and informs him that her mother wants to meet him. Meanwhile, Mi Rim desperately searches for Hyo Jun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim scolds Hyo Jun on behalf of Sun Soon, who has collapsed at the news of Mi Rim's pregnancy. Tae Ho grumbles sadly at Hyo Sim for having to leave Sun Soon's house. Myung Hee pressures Jin Bum to confess to the Daegwallyeong Pass incident, and later, Tae Min finds Jin Bum collapsed on the floor. Meanwhile, Sook Hyang frets about the prosecutor's investigation, and Mr. Yeom tells Tae Min that Myung Hee is behind it all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: Mi Rim's unexpected remarks turn Hyo Sim's house upside down, and Sun Soon falls ill again. Sook Hyang gets taken in for questioning by the prosecution, and Tae Ho searches for evidence one last time. Hyo Sung resorts to a loan shark for his children's education but runs into Hyo Do. Meanwhile, Tae Ho tries to earn brownie points with Hyo Sim's family by helping at the cafe, and Tae Min sees his world crumble as he learns Myung Hee's secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: Myung Hee reveals the truth to Tae Ho, but Tae Ho can't hide his bewilderment. Sun Soon succumbs to Mi Rim's determination and approves her wish to find her husband. Tae Min leaves his resignation letter and keeps himself out of sight, but Tae Ho finds him. Meanwhile, Hyo Do takes a beating from Mr. Yeom and his men when he goes to help Hyo Sung, and Sook Hyang offers TV Live a proposition that could destroy Taesan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: While Tae Ho and Tae Min stay up all night looking for a way to stop TV Live's attack on Taesan Group, they seem to become closer. Hyo Sim fervently spreads flyers to find her father and later comforts Tae Ho after learning about his relationship with Tae Min. Meanwhile, Tae Hee returns home after signing divorce papers and finds Mr. Yeom's attitude towards her suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim races to a piano academy and finds traces of her father there after hearing new information about him. Tae Ho warns Sook Hyang to leave Tae Min alone, and Sook Hyang plans to dump all crimes on Mr. Yeom. Ru Bi takes Pil Lip to Indangsu and learns everything about Hyo Sung's painful circumstances. Meanwhile, Jin Bum, who cannot contain his remorse, tells Tae Min the truth behind the Daegwallyeong incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: Jin Bum apologizes to Tae Min and says he will go to prison. Hyo Sung accidentally finds a picture of a woman at the piano academy with Hyo Sim that they believe was where their father last stayed. Myung Hee gives Tae Min the dashcam footage of the Daegwallyeong Pass incident, and Tae Min and Tae Ho learn what happened. Meanwhile, Hee Ju tells Sun Soon that Tae Ho belongs to the family that runs Taesan Group, and Sun Soon calls Hyo Sim over right away.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: Sook Hyang's longstanding deceitful behavior toward Mr. Yeom may soon have consequences. With Tae Min's help, Hyo Sung re-enters Taesan Group and persuades Hyo Sim to cease searching for their father. Tae Ho's visit to Uicheon Villa is an attempt to gain Sun Soon's approval for his marriage to Hyo Sim, but he is met with coldness from Sun Soon. Meanwhile, Tae Hee confides in Tae Min about a secret she has been keeping.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: Tae Min tells Tae Ho that he will take care of everything and for him to get married and live a happy life. Hyo Sung finds Mr. Yeom's old phone and gives it to Tae Min, and Tae Ho gets in touch with Park Jin Myung. Tae Ho valiantly tries to win Sun Soon's heart, and Sun Soon is stunned at his behavior. Meanwhile, Kkeut Soon is shocked when she sees her grandson, who is supposed to be in the US, in the cafe. She and Hyo Sim track him down to find out more.

Episodes.Title: Episode 47
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho and Tae Min reunite with Park Jin Myung when he returns to Korea to give them crucial documents that will put Sook Hyang away for good. Kkeut Soon locks herself in her room after her heart breaks over her family. While Myung Hee tries to console her, Taesan Group requests her return, and she has no choice but to leave Uicheon Villa. Meanwhile, Sun Soon sobs when she sees how beautiful Hyo Sim is on the runway of a fashion show, and Tae Ho takes Hyo Sim to where they first meet to propose to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 48
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim meets her father, Chu Ryeon, who doesn't recognize her, and she reveals who she is in his hospital room. Hyo Sung meets Mi Hee, his music instructor from when he was a child. And through her, he learns why his father had left his family. Tae Ho takes Sun Soon to meet Myung Hee about his marriage to Hyo Sim. Meanwhile, Tae Ho and Hyo Sung get promotions for their parts in revealing the truth, and Hyo Sim meets Mi Hee when she goes to see Chu Ryeon again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 49
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho becomes upset at Hyo Sim's words to postpone their wedding, and they fight over it. Sun Soon reunites with Chu Ryeon but collapses out of bitter anger. She warns Hyo Sung and Hyo Sim never to think about giving Chu Ryeon their liver. Tae Ho asks Tae Min to postpone his promotion, and Hyo Jun goes to take his lawyer's exam. Meanwhile, Hyo Sim's family takes matters into their own hands to protect their family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 50
Episodes.Description: Knowing Hyo Sim went into the operating room to donate her liver, Sun Soon sobs in agony in front of the doors. While worrying about Hyo Sim for being out of touch, Tae Ho realizes something horrible has happened when he sees Hyo Sung missing from his desk. After the surgery, Hyo Sim questions her life while watching her family restabilize at her sacrifice. Meanwhile, Tae Hee and Tae Min visit Sook Hyang at the corrections facility, and Tae Ho rushes to the hospital when he finds out about Hyo Sim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 51
Episodes.Description: It's been one year since Hyo Sim left, but Tae Ho still waits for her. Carrot is born, and Hyo Jun becomes a lawyer. Besides that, all is the same at Hyo Sim's house. However, they all reflect on how inconsiderate they were to Hyo Sim as they live on. Tae Min picks up Jin Bum, who is getting released with a special pardon, at the prison. Meanwhile, Tae Ho sees Hyo Sim in an interview on TV and rushes out to find her. Will Tae Ho and Hyo Sim's reunion be beautiful?

Entries.Title: The Kidnapping Day
Entries.Description: Myeong-jun accepts his ex-wife Hye-eun's proposal to kidnap an 11-year-old girl named Ro-hee to pay for his daughter's hospital bills. En route to execute his plan, someone collapses before his car, which turns out to be Ro-hee. He takes her home, but she can't remember anything when she wakes up. Myeong-jun claims to be her dad and contacts her parents for the ransom, but they can't be reached.

Episodes.Title: The Kidnapping
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun accepts his ex-wife Hye-eun's proposal to kidnap an 11-year-old girl named Ro-hee to pay for his daughter's hospital bills. En route to execute his plan, someone collapses before his car, which turns out to be Ro-hee. He takes her home, but she can't remember anything when she wakes up. Myeong-jun claims to be her dad and contacts her parents for the ransom, but they can't be reached.

Episodes.Title: False Accusation
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun finds out that Ro-hee's parents have been murdered. He can no longer demand ransom or bring Ro-hee back to her home. As he heads to Ro-hee's home, a suspicious figure approaches Ro-hee who is home alone. Meanwhile, Sang-yun, the detective in charge of the case of the murdered hospital director and his wife, learns of their daughter's kidnapping and begins tracing Myeong-jun's footsteps.

Episodes.Title: The Accomplice
Episodes.Description: Ro-hee finds out that Myeong-jun is not her dad but a kidnapper. Myeong-jun decides to take Ro-hee to the police station and turn himself in. Right then, Ro-hee regains a part of her memory and is left in shock. Meanwhile, Sang-yun discovers something about Myeong-jun's past.

Episodes.Title: The Monster
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun and Ro-hee stay the night at Hye-eun's house, the mastermind behind the kidnapping. Ro-hee is in disbelief when she discovers Myeong-jun's decision to take all the blame for kidnapping her. Ro-hee remains suspicious of Hye-eun and, in the end, finds out the real reason for Hye-eun leaving Myeong-jun and Hee-ae. Meanwhile, Sang-yun finally faces Myeong-jun after an unyielding pursuit.

Episodes.Title: The Genius Child
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun and Ro-hee find themselves in Choi Jin-tae's villa. Myeong-jun learns of "The Genius Child Project," a brain experiment Ro-hee was a subject in. Dr. Mo attempts to separate Ro-hee and Myeong-jun. Meanwhile, Sang-yun digs into a case from 30 years ago to catch the culprit of the hospital director and his wife's murder case and hears an unexpected name from a witness of a past case.

Episodes.Title: The Negotiation
Episodes.Description: Ro-hee's escape from Mo Eun-sun and Jaden is short-lived, as Jaden catches her. Myeong-jun finds himself waking up on a stowaway boat. He puts his life on the line and fights to return to Ro-Hee. Meanwhile, Sang-yun, who learns from Myeong-jun about Ro-hee's partially recovered memory, hears shocking news of a murder case while chasing Cheol-won.

Episodes.Title: The Mole
Episodes.Description: In an attempt to escape again, Myeong-jun and Ro-hee request help from someone. Jaden threatens Myeong-jun and Ro-hee as he receives a call from the kidnapper about a negotiation. Meanwhile, Sang-yun, investigating Hye-eun's connection to a murder case involving Cheol-won, discovers something about Dr. Choi Jin-tae's long-term experiment.

Episodes.Title: The First Child
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun turns to Sang-yun for help to save Ro-hee. However, Jaden, who deems Ro-hee as a subject of the experiment and an investment opportunity, also does not give up and pursues her. Meanwhile, Sang-yun, swayed by Myeong-jun's genuine concern for the kidnapped child, places his trust in Myeong-jun to turn himself in but gets put in a tough position when he doesn't show up.

Episodes.Title: The Girl
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun and Hye-eun's complicated past unravels, and Sang-yun remains resolute in his suspicions about Hye-eun. However, Sang-yun gets suspended for failing to apprehend Myeong-jun and can no longer investigate the murder and kidnapping cases. Meanwhile, Myeong-jun hides himself in Hye-eun's house and discovers a mysterious object. Myeong-jun's suspicions about Hye-eun begin to grow.

Episodes.Title: Counterattack
Episodes.Description: Hye-eun aims to exchange Choi Jin-tae's research material with Jaden, and her true colors come to light. Jaden attempts to send Ro-hee overseas along with the research material. However, Ro-hee searches for ways to escape her situation. Myeong-jun, who is struggling to save Ro-hee from Jaden, turns to Sang-yun for help, who continues to pursue Myeong-jun despite being suspended.

Episodes.Title: Smoking Gun
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun is torn between his suspicions of Hye-eun and his desire to believe in her. An alliance between the kidnapper, the kidnapped child, and the detectives in pursuit of them is formed to confront Jaden and his men. With their combined efforts, Ro-hee finally returns home, but an unexpected visitor appears.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun gets arrested in front of Ro-hee. Ro-hee and Sang-yun work together to prevent Myeong-jun from being falsely accused and to reveal the truth about the murder of the hospital director and his wife. Meanwhile, Hye-eun learns of Myeong-jun's arrest, finalizes her deal with Jaden, and leaves in search of freedom.

Entries.Title: Boyhood
Entries.Description: Onyang's bully Byung-tae transfers to Buyeo, and he feels daunted by the thought of adjusting to his new school. However, the bullies he encounters at his new school only watch Byung-tae's every move.

Episodes.Title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon: The Beginning of a Legend
Episodes.Description: Onyang's bully Byung-tae transfers to Buyeo, and he feels daunted by the thought of adjusting to his new school. However, the bullies he encounters at his new school only watch Byung-tae's every move.

Episodes.Title: My Love, Don't Cross That River
Episodes.Description: Byung-tae tries to tell her that he is being mistaken for the legendary fighter 'Asan Baekho', but misses his chance. Then, he saves Seon-hwa, the queen bee of Buyeo, from an awkward situation.

Episodes.Title: Why Can't We Stop Them
Episodes.Description: Jong-min, who had Seon-hwa stolen by Byeong-tae, storms into Nonggo to have a showdown with Byeong-tae. Byeong-tae and his group, enraged by this, prepare for a large-scale war with Buyeo Technical High School.

Episodes.Title: One Fine Spring Day
Episodes.Description: Kyung-tae transfers to the same class. Byeong-tae has an intuition that he is Asan Baekho. Meanwhile, someone comes to find Byeong-tae, who is on a sweet date with Seon-hwa.

Episodes.Title: Love and War
Episodes.Description: Ji-young advises Byung-tae, who is running for student body president, not to run, but Byung-tae ignores her. Meanwhile, someone appears who irritates Byung-tae.

Episodes.Title: Everything, Everywhere, All at Once
Episodes.Description: The real Asan Baekho is revealed, and Buyeo Agricultural High School begins to be turbulent. Byung-tae returns to his life as a lowlife. Byung-tae's love and friendship become increasingly endangered.

Episodes.Title: Love Me Once Again
Episodes.Description: Byung-tae loses everything, but Kyung-tae runs for student council president, throws a grand birthday party, and even wins Seon-hwa. Meanwhile, the long-awaited student council president election day approaches.

Episodes.Title: A Bloody Battle for Revenge
Episodes.Description: Byung-tae's father, who was framed, is taken to the police station, but Byung-tae can do nothing. In the end, Byung-tae decides to gain strength for revenge, and Ji-young helps him.

Episodes.Title: The Foul King
Episodes.Description: The breathtaking revenge of Byung-tae, hidden behind a mask, begins. Byung-tae receives special tutoring from Ji-young and begins a one-on-one customized operation to defeat the agricultural high school gang.

Episodes.Title: Six Flying Dragons
Episodes.Description: Ji-young is worried as she watches Byung-tae's injuries worsen. Meanwhile, Byung-tae comes up with a trick to defeat Asan Baekho. Will Byung-tae's revenge be successful?

Entries.Title: Family: The Unbreakable Bond
Entries.Description: Kwon Do-hun is an affectionate husband and father, but he is always late or absent at every family event because of his overwhelming work. After putting up for ten years, Kang Yu-ra finally loses her temper and invites Do-hun's ruthless supervisor, Chief Oh Cheon-ryeon, to their home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Kwon Do-hun is an affectionate husband and father, but he is always late or absent at every family event because of his overwhelming work. After putting up for ten years, Kang Yu-ra finally loses her temper and invites Do-hun's ruthless supervisor, Chief Oh Cheon-ryeon, to their home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Even after meeting Chief Oh, Yu-ra can hardly discard her suspicions. Meanwhile, Do-hun prepares an event at a luxury hotel for his wife.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5

Episodes.Title: Episode 6

Episodes.Title: Episode 7

Episodes.Title: Episode 9

Director expresses his suspicions about Chief Oh being involved in Butterfly’s murder, while at the NIS headquarters, Ma Young-ji tells Chief Oh about Butterfly’s situation and mentions Do-hun was the only agent who was there when Butterfly was killed. It turns out Chief Oh didn’t know Do-hun was the one sent to kill Butterfly.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: The story when Do-hun first met Yu-ra.

She overpowers the attacker and shoots him. Just then, Ma Young-ji calls to inform her that there’s something wrong at the NIS headquarters.

Entries.Title: Brain Works

Episodes.Description: Dr. Shin Ha-ru is fired after illegally acquiring a criminal’s brain. He volunteers to help Detective Geum Myeong-se's bureau — and to make him pay.

Episodes.Title: The Most Brilliant Moment
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru and Myeong-se's first case involves a famous guitarist and his wife, who turned herself in for his murder. But Ha-ru turns the case on its head.

Entries.Title: Unintentional Love Story
Entries.Description: After his immediate manager got fired for corruption, Ji Won Young lost his job of two years as well, as he is thought to have been involved. Not knowing what to do, Won Young takes a trip outside of the city to rest. To his surprise, he meets Yoon Tae Joon, the company CEO's favorite artist. After his superior tells him that he should find out why Yoon Tae Joon disappeared without a trace two years ago, Won Young decides to pursue a part-time job at Tae Joon's pottery shop. But Tae Joon seems not in the least inclined to take on a part-timer or get close to anyone. Trying his best, Won Young helps the town and community in the hopes of landing a part-time job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After his immediate manager got fired for corruption, Ji Won Young lost his job of two years as well, as he is thought to have been involved. Not knowing what to do, Won Young takes a trip outside of the city to rest. To his surprise, he meets Yoon Tae Joon, the company CEO's favorite artist. After his superior tells him that he should find out why Yoon Tae Joon disappeared without a trace two years ago, Won Young decides to pursue a part-time job at Tae Joon's pottery shop. But Tae Joon seems not in the least inclined to take on a part-timer or get close to anyone. Trying his best, Won Young helps the town and community in the hopes of landing a part-time job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Tae Joon confronts Won Young about his intentions. With a little trick, Won Young manages to call in a favour and gets to participate in Tae Joon's pottery class. Despite originally only being interested in Tae Joon, Won Young starts to like pottery. When the class ends, Won Young asks Tae Joon for a ride back and they grow closer on the way. Won Young becomes witness to one of Ho Tae's common breakups with his girlfriends, seeing him get hit and slapped. Worried he takes him to Dong Hee's coffee shop and has him get treated, leading to an uncomfortable confrontation between Dong Hee and Ho Tae.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Won Young almost gets caught by Tae Joon while talking to the Vice-President, but he realises that Tae Joon only wants to give him his first finished pottery work as a present. Despite his happiness over the finished work, Won Young finds out that the inn he was staying at is going under construction, meaning he won't have anywhere to stay. Planning on finding a place, he continues working at the coffee shop but starts feeling ill. When arriving at the pottery class, Tae Joon sends him home to rest as he is clearly sick. After visiting the hospital and finding out it is more serious and he shall take a rest, he is taken in by Tae Joon, who offers to let him stay at his house. Despite their initial difficulties living together, they soon find common ground and grow closer. Dong Hee, who has no part-timer helping him anymore, struggles to keep the deliveries going. Ho Tae decides to come to his rescue and offers to help.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: With Won Young and Tae Joon growing closer, Won Young feels his heart flutter even more and wonders what it might mean. After Tae Joon visits his former professor in the hospital, he has an unpleasant encounter with someone else from his past. Stressed out due to the memories, he disappears for a day, worrying Won Young, who finds him with a high fever in the living room the following evening. Desperate to help him, Won Young cares for Tae Joon until he is recovered. Tae Joon takes Won Young on a trip to his studio, and they spend the day together getting closer and learning about pottery. Ho Tae, who helped Dong Hee out while Won Young was sick, grows weary when Dong Hee doesn't seem to care about him. He reminisces over old memories of them and asks Dong Hee to take him out to eat as it is his last day in the coffee shop. At the beach, they run into Won Young and Tae Joon. A tipsy Won Young asks Tae Joon if he has someone he likes

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Asking Dong Hee to grant him a wish, Ho Tae wants them to date for a month, angering Dong Hee, who punches him. Despite this, Ho Tae continues trying to get them to date, leading to a confrontation between them. Ready to get hit by Ho Tae, Dong Hee is shocked when he receives a kiss instead but clearly refuses to believe in Ho Tae's feelings. Won Young continues living with Tae Joon and becomes increasingly confused about his feelings. Tae Joon, finally aware of his own emotions, tries to grow closer. Worried about misunderstanding their interactions and thinking Tae Joon likes someone else, Won Young declares his decision to move out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After moving out, Won Young tries to be still close to Tae Joon but receives the cold shoulder. Dong Hee invites Tae Joon out to drink to discuss their situation with Won Young and Ho Tae, but Tae Joon leaves in a hurry when he finds out Ho Tae and Won Young are buying study books together that evening. Ho Tae confronts Won Young about seeing Ho Tae kiss Dong Hee, but they reach a common understanding that liking someone is not wrong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: After Won Young and Tae Joon finally confess their feelings for each other, they spend a day at the beach before soon returning to their daily lives. While keeping their relationship secret, they grow closer and exchange more intimate details about each other. Ho Tae confronts Dong Hee about his confession and suggests that maybe Dong Hee is not angry because he asked to date but because he only said: "for one month".

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: With the Vice-President of the company revealing Won Young's original intentions in getting close to Tae Joon, Tae Joon is devastated but keeps his promise of visiting Won Young in his rented room. After purposefully testing him, Won Young keeps refusing to confess, angering Tae Joon, who breaks down and admits he knows the truth. Angry and hurt, he confronts Won Young about his charade and demands that they never see each other again. Won Young, devastated, tries to find an opportunity to talk but only receives the cold shoulder. To torture Won Young for breaking his heart, Tae Joon agrees to the exclusive deal with the company, resulting in Won Young getting his job back and raising his guilty conscience.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Won Young went back to work at Taepyeong. He's determined to beg for Tae Joon's forgiveness. His incessant efforts started to pay off. Dong Hee and Ho Tae's past was revealed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: A misunderstanding almost broke Won Young's spirit and stopped him from pursuing Tae Joon's forgiveness. The conclusion of their relationship ensued, as well as Ho Tae and Dong Hee's.

Episodes.Title: We Were Someone's Young-sim And Kyung-tae
Episodes.Description: Min-ji and Woo-chan's episode begins filming, but Kyung-tae's personality gets in the way. As Young-sim and Kyung-tae try to make things work between Min-ji and Woo-chan, they can't help but realize the similarity to their brief childhood romance. Meanwhile, Woo-chan learns what happened in the past, and Young-sim goes on a date.

Episodes.Title: For Our Humiliating Past
Episodes.Description: Young-sim and Kyung-tae fall deeply for each other. Despite their happy days as a couple, another incident occurs that tests their relationship again. Wol-sook schemes to make reporters write articles that say she and Kyung Tae are dating. Although Kyung-tae wants to get the facts straight, Young-sim sees this as an opportunity to promote her show.

Entries.Title: Like Flowers in Sand
Entries.Description: Feeling despondent about his footing in the ssireum world, Kim Baek-du competes in a new tournament — coming up against a formidable opponent.

Episodes.Title: Ssireum Prodigy, Kim Baek-du
Episodes.Description: Feeling despondent about his footing in the ssireum world, Kim Baek-du competes in a new tournament — coming up against a formidable opponent.

Episodes.Title: There's Something About Oh Du-sik
Episodes.Description: Baek-du encounters an old friend who persistently denies knowing him. But he later sees her become the manager of his team and deduces her identity.

Episodes.Title: Du-sik Is Not Her Name
Episodes.Description: No longer a wrestler, Baek-du contemplates other career paths. After the coach suddenly quits the team, Oh Yu-gyeong tries to get to the bottom of it.

Episodes.Title: I Know What You Did That Day
Episodes.Description: Kwak Jin-su challenges Baek-du to a ssireum match for the role of coach. But the match is interrupted when the police take Baek-du away for questioning.

Episodes.Title: Kim Baek-du, I See Right Through You
Episodes.Description: After finding out Yu-gyeong's ruse, Baek-du rejoins the ssireum team. They later pay a visit to Lim Dong-seok to investigate the former coach.

Episodes.Title: What Cannot Be Hidden
Episodes.Description: Amid the ongoing investigation, Baek-du trains for an upcoming match. But when Jin-su suddenly sidelines Baek-du, Yu-gyeong stands up for him.

Episodes.Title: New Day, New Incident
Episodes.Description: Baek-du experiences several roadblocks as he tries to make his upcoming competition — and during his matches, he can't stop thinking about Yu-gyeong.

Episodes.Title: Remember, Don't Remember
Episodes.Description: After 20 years, Yu-gyeong meets with Joo Mi-ran to talk through unsolved business. While drunkenly catching up with Yu-gyeong, Baek-du makes a move.

Episodes.Title: All That We Have Lost
Episodes.Description: Ready to share more information, Mi-ran pays a visit to Yu-gyeong and Baek-du. Rumors of a scandal between Yu-gyeong and Baek-du circulate around town.

Episodes.Title: Endlessly Tangled, Persistently Intertwined
Episodes.Description: Baek-du awaits Yu-gyeong's response after a momentous confession. Meanwhile, several old friends begin to figure out Yu-gyeong's true identity.

Episodes.Title: The Culprit Lives Among Us
Episodes.Description: Old friends join forces to find the culprit hiding in their town. But when they hit a standstill, Mi-ran sets herself up as bait — much to her risk.

Episodes.Title: Like Flowers in Sand
Episodes.Description: With Mi-ran in danger, Yu-gyeong races to save her. Baek-du gives it his all in the tournament — hoping a win will secure a spot in Yu-gyeong's heart.

Entries.Title: Love Tractor
Entries.Description: Seon Yul, a city man feeling lost and temporarily relocated to his grandfather's rural home. He's unaccustomed to the countryside and faces challenges adapting to rural life. Meanwhile, Ye Chan, a passionate young man who loves farming, is introduced as someone who adores the countryside. Their paths cross, and Seon Yul gradually becomes drawn to Ye Chan's nature as he learns about rural life and helps with farming tasks.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Seon Yul, a city man feeling lost and temporarily relocated to his grandfather's rural home. He's unaccustomed to the countryside and faces challenges adapting to rural life. Meanwhile, Ye Chan, a passionate young man who loves farming, is introduced as someone who adores the countryside. Their paths cross, and Seon Yul gradually becomes drawn to Ye Chan's nature as he learns about rural life and helps with farming tasks.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Seon Yul begins his journey of rural adaptation, becoming increasingly drawn to Yechan's sincerity and enthusiasm.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Seonyul, a city man experiencing rural life, and Yechan, a passionate young man who loves farming, continue to develop their connection. Seonyul struggles with the unfamiliarity of farm life, while Yechan helps him learn and adjusts to their shared environment. Their relationship, as well as Seonyul's overall journey, continues to unfold.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Seonyul, the city man, continues to struggle with rural life, while Yechan, the passionate farmer, starts to show more affection for Seonyul. Seonyul's attempts to fit in, like working with the animals and trying to make friends with the local children, reveal his awkwardness and lack of experience.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Yul struggles with his feelings for Yechan while Inseo, who seems to be an unwanted character, continues to cling to Yul. Yechan's sweetness and the subtle hint of spice foreshadow a growing romantic tension.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Seon Yul, a city man struggling to adapt to rural life, continues to learn about farming and the countryside, while becoming increasingly attracted to the passionate and enthusiastic Yechan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Seonyul, a city man, and Yechan, a rural man, continue their journey of healing and love in the countryside. Their relationship deepens, with Yul's "can't hold back you're too cool" piano kiss and a bracelet exchange marking significant milestones.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Seon Yul, feeling lost and seeking solace, moves to his grandfather's rural home. There, he encounters Yechan, a passionate young man who loves farming, and Seon Yul begins to adapt to rural life and engage in farming activities. Seon Yul gradually becomes drawn to Yechan's sincerity and enthusiasm.

Entries.Title: RACE
Entries.Description: PR agency staff Yoon-jo gets a presentation chance from a top company, Seyong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: PR agency staff Yoon-jo gets a presentation chance from a top company, Seyong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Yoon-jo's effort fails, and she moves on to another project. Seyong begins a new recruitment project.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Yoon-jo gets hired by Seyong through Spec-Out recruitment. The news of the new CCO makes a stir.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Yoonjo is busy with the promotion of Spec-Out. Soon, an article suspecting unfair hiring is posted.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Yoon-jo is assailed by doubts and Jae-min tries to reveal the truth. Yi-jung calls the PR department.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Jae-min is forced to assist Team 1. Yoon-jo takes on the cosmetics task and gets closer to Dong-hoon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Yoon-jo's proposal for Celltics BI revamp shocks the company. She confesses her feelings to Jae-min.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Yoon-jo and Jae-min feel awkward in the TF team. Jae-min sees Dong-hoon confess his feelings to Yoon-jo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: A negative publicity plan concerns Yoon-jo. The CEO's social media post undermines Yi-jung's position.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Negative publicity gets Yoon-jo in trouble. Jae-min finds faked data and is accused of whistleblowing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Jae-min and Yoon-jo meet Yi-jung at the personnel committee. Meanwhile, Jae-min has confused emotions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: A wind of change is blowing in Seyong. Everyone has to choose what is most important and valuable.

Entries.Title: Delivery Man
