Entries.Description: A ghost gets in Young Min's taxi, and she can't leave it for an inexplicable reason. What's worse is that Young Min learns that the house he's living in with his grandma will get auctioned off if he doesn't pay the mortgage. Luckily, Ji Hyun, the ghost, has an idea to help him make the money he needs to save his house.

Episodes.Title: Young-Min Meets Ji Hyun
Episodes.Description: A ghost gets in Young Min's taxi, and she can't leave it for an inexplicable reason. What's worse is that Young Min learns that the house he's living in with his grandma will get auctioned off if he doesn't pay the mortgage. Luckily, Ji Hyun, the ghost, has an idea to help him make the money he needs to save his house.

Episodes.Title: Young-Min Decides to Help a Ghost
Episodes.Description: The plan to make money for the mortgage goes to waste, and Young Min is upset about it. Ji Hyun persuades Young Min to help Byung Chul, and they decide to help Byung Chul and his wife So Yeon. So Yeon was about to receive compensation money from Byung Chul’s company, but a woman who claims to be Byung Chul’s mother appears. Young Min gets suspicious about the woman’s identity.

Episodes.Title: Young-min's Mother's Hairband
Episodes.Description: Young-min notices that the hairband on Ji-hyun's wrist is his late mother's. However, Ji-hyun doesn't remember anything about it or why she has it. Making things more confusing are the pictures of Ji-hyun and his mother together before the accident found on his mother's phone. Meanwhile, the police call Young-hin in for questioning about his mother's death, suspecting him of his involvement.

Episodes.Title: A Popular Spot for Ghosts
Episodes.Description: Now that Ji-hyun is gone, Young-min makes some decent money. However, something inside him longs for her return, and he finds a way to charge the cell phone to bring her back. When Ji-hyun returns, they run into the Jayu-ro ghost, who points them to a popular ghost location. Meanwhile, the police think the hit-and-run case and Ji-hyun's incident are related.

Episodes.Title: The Missing Young Girl
Episodes.Description: Young-min can't stand the thought of Ji-hyun leaving him. When Young-min takes her to see Sin-woo to fulfill his contract, he changes his mind. Meanwhile, a young boy gets in Young-min's taxi and asks for Young-min to grant his wish.

Episodes.Title: Young-min Hearts Ji-hyun
Episodes.Description: Ji-hyun sticks to Ga-eun to find Ha-yul, the young girl who had gone missing. Young-min doesn't give up after fighting off a bunch of thugs and manages to convince Ga-eun to tell him the truth. Meanwhile, as Young-min fulfills Ji-hyun's wishes one at a time, he conveys his feelings for her.

Episodes.Title: The Downside of Falling in Love
Episodes.Description: Ji-hyun sticks to Ga-eun to find Ha-yul, the young girl who had gone missing. Young-min doesn't give up after fighting off a bunch of thugs and manages to convince Ga-eun to tell him the truth. Meanwhile, as Young-min fulfills Ji-hyun's wishes one at a time, he conveys his feelings for her.

Episodes.Title: The Mysterious Photos
Episodes.Description: On the first date with Ji-hyun, Young-min wonders why the rule of ascending to the sky doesn't apply to Ji-hyun, and that offends her. Young-min and Ji-hyun help find Doo-kang’s daughter. In return, he provides information on Nurse Kim Jung-woo. Ji-hyun and Young-min head to the studio apartment building where a faceless ghost appears, and they run into her.

Episodes.Title: The Mysterious Vacation Home
Episodes.Description: Young-min gets caught while coming out of Kim Jung-woo’s studio and gets arrested for trespassing. After finding out that Kang Hyung-soo is Ji-hyun’s dad, Young-min asks him how she died. Meanwhile, Eun-soo’s mother falls and hurts herself. Gyu-jin treats her, but something goes wrong with her.

Episodes.Title: The Man Behind the Murders
Episodes.Description: Gyu-jin drops by Young-min's house to see if Young-min has found any evidence. He finds out that Young-min has no solid evidence to back up his suspicion. Meanwhile, Young-min finds the note that Nurse Kim Hee-yeon left Jung-woo, so he confronts her. On the way home, Young-min gets attacked from behind and kidnapped.

Episodes.Title: Beg for My Mercy
Episodes.Description: Young-min gets saved by Ji-hyun and escapes from the fire. Young-min reports to the police that all the murders were done by Do Gyu-jin. After a police investigation, Gyu-jin flees, and Young-min finds out his hiding spot. When Young-min confronts him, Gyu-jin threatens to destroy the most important piece of evidence.

Episodes.Title: The Real Culprit
Episodes.Description: Kim Hee-yeon makes a false statement and claims that she’s responsible for all the murders that happened at Deahun Medical Center. Gyu-jin learns that Ji-hyun is still alive and that she was transferred to his hospital. When he’s about to inject a drug to kill Ji-hyun again, Young-min jumps in and catches him in the act.

Entries.Title: Our Blooming Youth
Entries.Description: A rumor about how Prince Hwan has been cursed by a ghost has spread throughout the country. He has a dark secret he can't tell anyone. People who are trying to get Hwan dethroned prepare a trap and Hwan must stand against them. Meanwhile, the one who killed Hwan's Master comes to see him of her own free will.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A rumor about how Prince Hwan has been cursed by a ghost has spread throughout the country. He has a dark secret he can't tell anyone. People who are trying to get Hwan dethroned prepare a trap and Hwan must stand against them. Meanwhile, the one who killed Hwan's Master comes to see him of her own free will.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After facing a crisis at the hunting grounds, Hwan finds himself in an unbelievable situation. Jae-yi claims that she's innocent and blames Hwan for the death of her family. Hwan is confused when he finds out Jae-yi knows about his secret. Meanwhile, Jae-yi's servant disguises herself as a man to learn from the mad scientist, Kim Myeong-jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hwan can't trust Jae-yi and tells her to come find him in the East Palace on her own. To get there, Jae-yi turns herself into a eunuch. Meanwhile, Seong-on is shock to learn that his father might have something to do with the written prayer incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Hwan gives Jae-yi a second test. She must figure out why the messenger he sent to Master Min's house was killed and Jae-yi finds out it has something to do with Hwan. And finally, Hwan gives the last test which is to solve a serial murdercase. Now Jae-yi must face her fiancé.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Hwan, Jae-yi, Myeong-jin and Ga-ram finally meet. They head out to solve the Cardinal Point case. Meanwhile, Seong-on feels humiliated since he's competing against Sun-dol and feels upset when he sees Hwan and Sun-dol together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Jae-yi proves herself by solving the Cardial Point case and Hwan starts to trust her. Hwan listens to what happened to Jae-yi's family and trusts that she is innocent. Seong-on and Jae-yi run into each other by accident and she finds out Seong-on has been carrying something that has something to do with her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: After Hwan decides that he can't trust Jae-yi, he kicks her out of the palace. Ga-ram is ordered a chusoeryeong and is put in danger. Seong-on is curious as to why Hwan is looking into the case of his ex-fiancé and Hwan feels lonely now more than ever without Jae-yi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The Prince's Guards and the War Department has a match of polo while Jae-yi watches. The interrogation of the shaman begins and she starts to curse the royal family which brings chaos to the capital and the palace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: The palace and the capital is in chaos after the shaman's curse. Cho Won-bo turns the crisis into an opportunity and starts to pressure the royal family. Hwan and Jae-yi tried to prove that a human set fire to the plum tree and they find out that the real culpirt is someone they didn't expect.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: After finding the royal secretary's journal suspicious, Hwan starts investigating what happened in Byeokcheon and the dried peony petals. After getting a mysterious letter, Cho Won-bo tries to subjugate the remnants of the thieves.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Hwan teams up with Jae-yi and Seong-on to find a way to leave the palace after getting confined. Jae-yi finally remembers the face of the messenger who was at her house and is in shock. She runs to Hwan after realizing he's in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Jae-yi claims that her memories are true, but Hwan trusts Tae-kang which confuses Jae-yi even more. Meanwhile, to each Myung-jin a lesson, Ga-ram steps up. Hwan leaves with Jae-yi and Seong-on after finding the man who tampered with the written prayer is in Paju and get themselves in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: After returning to the palace, Hwan tries to send Jae-yi to Seong-on because he doesn't want Jae-yi to get hurt anymore. Meanwhile, a mysterious woman comes to Seong-on's house. The bounty hunters go to Jo Won-bo about Ga-ram and while having a good time at the inn, Hwan, Jae-yi, Myung-jin and Ga-ram are faced with another murder case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: The Manyeondang group manages to get the bracelet Shim Yeong gave to Jae-yi and start to figure out how Jae-yi's family was murdered. The King announces that the Crown Princess selection will take place soon, so Hwan gets ready to let Jae-yi go. Meanwhile, Prince Myeong-han, who was suffering from nightmares, says something shocking.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: The Queen is furious that Won-bo used her son, Prince Myeong-ahn. Hwan tries to meet Park Han-su to find out what happened in Byeokcheon, but Jo Won-bo makes a move first to stop him from talking. Meanwhile, Princess Ha-yeon makes a risky decision to help Prince Myeong-ahn get better and the Manyeongdang group takes a huge step toward the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Princess Ha-yeon and Prince Myeong-ahn leaves the palace to meet Monk Mu-jin and an assassin follows them. Hwan and Jae-yi ask Tae-kang about the new mystery they unfolded, but Tae-kang says he doesn't know anything about it. Meanwhile, the Queen tells Seong-on the truth about Jae-yi and Jae-yi finds herself in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Seong-on finds out Sun-dol is acutally Min Jae-yi and feels betrayed. Meanwhile, Tae-kang tells Hwan everything about his secret. Hwan, Jae-yi, Myung-jin and Ga-ram takes one step closer to the truth and starts to track down the secret letter Min Ho-seung left behind, but another crisis hits them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: After finding out what's written in the jikgeumdo, Hwan and Han Jung-eon are in shock and Jae-yi gets arrested for murder. Hwan is even more shocked to hear Jae-yi admit everything. Jo Won-bo demands that the Crown Prince gets deposed. Meanwhile, Seong-on gets an order from the Queen in secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: After finding out about the Queen's secret, Jo Won-bo is furious and the Queen makes a decision when Won-bo threatens her son. Meanwhile, the six arrive at Naewang Village and Hwan tries to convince them. Just then, Jo Won-bo comes once again to slaughter them.

Entries.Title: One Day Off
Entries.Description: Tired of teaching her seemingly unresponsive students, Park Ha-kyung takes off to a temple in a remote part of Haenam. That's when she crosses paths with a silent stranger seeking inner peace, and they set out on a walk together. After taking deep breaths and meditating, she finally finds peace to unshackle her mind.

Episodes.Title: Unshackling the Mind
Episodes.Description: Tired of teaching her seemingly unresponsive students, Park Ha-kyung takes off to a temple in a remote part of Haenam. That's when she crosses paths with a silent stranger seeking inner peace, and they set out on a walk together. After taking deep breaths and meditating, she finally finds peace to unshackle her mind.

Episodes.Title: Dreams and Hand-Dripped Sorrow
Episodes.Description: After spouting clichéd advice about pursuing music to her student, Park Ha-kyung yearns for a breather. In Gunsan, she visits a former pupil holding an art exhibition, and there she rediscovers her old self cheering on young dreams.

Episodes.Title: Meta-Romance
Episodes.Description: Ha-kyung makes her way to the Busan International Film Festival, ready to be immersed in cinematic magic. As she settles to catch a film, her eyes lock with those of a stranger. From then on, they keep bumping into each other – at a noodle joint, a used book store, and a subway station.

Episodes.Title: The Way Back
Episodes.Description: Ha-kyung dials up customer service when her parents lose their Internet connection. After an exhausting marathon on the phone, she decides to clear her head in Sokcho. But things take an unexpected turn at the bus terminal when she gets embroiled in a heated argument. Past experiences clash with forward-thinking opinions, but when loved ones enter the picture, all that tension melts away miraculously.

Episodes.Title: Dance Even If You Trip
Episodes.Description: Thanks to a missed train, Ha-kyung takes a delightful detour to Daejeon. Caught up in the beauty of dancing, stargazing, and breaking bread with an amicable stranger, she explores what it means to be off track. After all, travel and life are all about losing your way into the unknown.

Episodes.Title: Rainy Saturday
Episodes.Description: Ha-kyung finds herself in the eye of a storm – enraged parents protest a gaming tournament while students are excited about it. There is even a downpour keeping her in Seoul. After meandering through the drenched streets, she crosses paths with the school's art teacher and his pupils. Will this encounter give her some answers?

Episodes.Title: The Island of Bread
Episodes.Description: Ha-kyung wings her way to Jeju, where her eyes are set on the island's top dozen bakeries. But her breadventure takes an unexpected turn with a little girl looking for "snail bread." What exactly is snail bread? And why is a child set on finding it? Ha-kyung can't help but unravel this knead-to-know mystery!

Episodes.Title: Back to Gyeongju
Episodes.Description: Ha-kyung steps foot again in Gyeongju, a city that echoes her high school field trip. All alone this time, she retraces the steps of her best friend, Jin-sol. As memories engulf her, a gentle reminder faces her again – growing up can wait, so let's embrace the present.

Entries.Title: Longing For You
Entries.Description: Young Ju carries out the interrogation with Bae Min Gyu, the victim's husband, but there is no solid evidence of the crime. Furthermore, his lover, Lee Eun Byeol submits a new alibi for him, and he gets released once again. Meanwhile, another hideous murder case occurs with a similar display.

Episodes.Title: Art Gallery Murder Case
Episodes.Description: Young Ju carries out the interrogation with Bae Min Gyu, the victim's husband, but there is no solid evidence of the crime. Furthermore, his lover, Lee Eun Byeol submits a new alibi for him, and he gets released once again. Meanwhile, another hideous murder case occurs with a similar display.

Episodes.Title: The Ankle Murderer
Episodes.Description: A detective who was chasing the real culprit of a serial murder case faces the hidden secret of his family. Jin-sung is a cheerful yet nasty-tempered detective at Woojin Police Station who fights for justice with all his heart. Meanwhile, Young Ju is a competent prosecutor with a high winning rate who believes that injustice must be punished through injustice. She is also an old friend of Jin-sung and Jin-woo. Jin-sung transfers to a special investigation team in Seoul for serial murder cases and carries out the investigation with Young-ju. However, Jin-woo, Jin-sung's brother, gets arrested as a suspect of the serial murders.

Episodes.Title: Lee Sung-yong's Statement
Episodes.Description: Jin-woo gets released and Jin-sung manages to obtain crucial evidence to arrest Bae Min-gyu. However, when the arrest warrant was issued, another suspect of the three serial murders appeared. Meanwhile, Jung-sook wants Young-woon to quit his job and move to the US with the family.

Episodes.Title: Accident At The Seaside
Episodes.Description: On a stormy night, Jin-woo gets into an accident at the seaside. Jin-sung and Young-ju get help from Jung-sook to transfer him to Jinjin Medical Center in Seoul. He may be brain-dead in the worst-case scenario, but Jin-sung and Young-ju believe that he will wake up. Meanwhile, Young-woon is being sent to training abroad as a reward for solving the serial murder.

Episodes.Title: Back in Action
Episodes.Description: Jin Sung receives two videos sent by an anonymous sender, and he’s shocked to discover that the videos show his brother Jin Woo being murdered. Similarly, Ko Young Ju also receives a video of a murder with a warning that the real culprit is someone else. These revelations lead the special task force to reopen the case, and they uncover new leads in their investigation.

Episodes.Title: A New Suspect
Episodes.Description: The Special Task Force was able to identify the source of the leak about the warrant, but the damage had already been done. The team is to disband, and prosecutors Young Ju and Young Woon face disciplinary action. However, this isn’t enough to stop the team, as they identify a new suspect.

Episodes.Title: A Trap
Episodes.Description: Jin Sung is shocked at discovering Park Ki Young’s room is identical to Young Woon’s room. He alerts Hee Ju, who is still with Ki Young, of his findings. However, it is too late as Hee Ju is kidnapped by Ki Young. With the police searching everywhere for Ki Young, the Task Force set up a trap anticipating that he will try to get in contact with Min Gyu.

Episodes.Title: The Perfect Crime
Episodes.Description: Jin Sung arrives at Young Ju's apartment only to find out that he is late and she has already been kidnapped. Now, Jin Sung must locate Ki Young before he harms Hee Ju and Young Ju. Even though the police are looking for Ki Young, he remains confident of his perfect crime. Will Jin Sung and Young Woon be able to successfully arrest Ki Young and rescue Hee Ju and Young Ju?

Episodes.Title: Digging In Deep
Episodes.Description: Park Ki Young is found dead, and now Ko Young Ju and Cha Young Woon must charge Bae Min Gyu with the serial murders. The chief prosecutor is relieved to see his daughter back safely and wants to close the case, but Young Woon and Young Ju sense there's more to Ki Young's death and request further investigation.

Episodes.Title: The Dark Truth
Episodes.Description: Jung Woo No instructed Dr. Chu to monitor Jin Woo closely. Although Woo No argues it was for research purposes, Jin Sung investigates deeper into the matter. As the investigation progresses further, Jung Woo No becomes more questionable. With increasing evidence pointing to Jung Woo No as the main suspect, the concealed truth becomes increasingly evident.

Episodes.Title: Pick Your Side
Episodes.Description: As the investigation into Jin Woo's death progresses, the case becomes increasingly clear. However, with his family and friends being involved in the case, Young Woon's resolve begins to waver. His family, friends, and even his memories challenge his choices. As the investigation team clashes with Jinjin Group, the time has come for Young Woon to pick his side.

Episodes.Title: The Lurking Presence
Episodes.Description: Marie admits that Park Ki Young initially approached her with evidence of Jin Woo’s murder, prompting the investigation team to delve into Park Ki Young’s past. They question a friend of Ki Young’s mother and uncover new information. However, due to Marie’s change in stance, Director Yoo becomes aware of a traitor leaking information nearby. (Source: Viu)

Episodes.Title: Questions Asked And Answered
Episodes.Description: Although Director Yoo uses her influence to wiggle out of the case, the special task force arrests Jung Woo No and Director Yoo to bring them in for questioning. Even though the special task force has gathered numerous pieces of evidence, Prosecutor Ko must carefully plan her move during the interrogation to wrap up this case.

Episodes.Title: The Trial
Episodes.Description: Director Yoo and Jung Woo No stand in court as the defendants. Prosecutor Ko is missing the decisive evidence. Jung Woo No admits to abducting and locking up Ki Young but claims Jin Woo's case was not a premeditated murder. Director Yoo denies any involvement in the crime. Will Prosecutor Ko achieve justice?

Entries.Title: Battle for Happiness
Entries.Description: While selecting the winners for a social media event, Jang Mi-ho gets in touch with Yu-jin, a bad relationship from her past. Meanwhile, Yu-jin is cornered by other moms who suspect her of lying for the main role in a play. One day, Mi-ho shows up in front of Yu-jin and fearing that her past will be discovered, Yu-jin gives money to Mi-ho to silence her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: While selecting the winners for a social media event, Jang Mi-ho gets in touch with Yu-jin, a bad relationship from her past. Meanwhile, Yu-jin is cornered by other moms who suspect her of lying for the main role in a play. One day, Mi-ho shows up in front of Yu-jin and fearing that her past will be discovered, Yu-jin gives money to Mi-ho to silence her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Because of an incident during the play, the event is suspended, and Yu-jin and Ji-ye argue over whose fault it is. Yu-jin accepts Mi-ho's offer to shoot a commercial, but the shoot is canceled when Ha-yul gets hurt on set. The emotional rift between the two deepens. Mi-ho goes to Yu-jin's house to apologize, but is kicked out. The next day, Mi-ho hears shocking news about Yu-jin...

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Rumors spread at work that Mi-ho is directly involved in Yu-jin's death. Meanwhile, Mi-ho goes to the aquarium with Ji-yul and Ha-yul. While returning to work with a complicated mind, she gets a call that the girls have disappeared. It turns out that they got lost while going to see Mi-ho. Mi-ho decides to take time off work to care for Ji-yul and Ha-yul, and moves into ‘High Prestige.’

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Mi-ho is clumsy in everything about childrearing, and she doesn't fit in properly with other moms. Na-young shows hostility towards Mi-ho and Mi-ho learns from Ji-ye that Yu-jin had a grudge against Na-young in her lifetime. After Mi-ho witnesses Na-young's serious delusional jealousy that doubts her husband's conduct, she finds a picture of Tae-ho's affair in Yu-jin's house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Mi-ho takes the pictures of Tae-ho’s affair to the police but fails to see the detective in charge. After an argument with Mi-ho, Na-young goes to Jung-ah to kick Mi-ho out, but Jung-ah doesn’t comply. When Mi-ho learns Tae-ho is having an affair with A-ra, she decides to apologize to Na-young. Meanwhile, after being humiliated by the other moms over lunch, Na-young decides to hang herself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Mi-ho finds Na-young just in time and saves her life. When words get out about Na-young’s suicide attempt, Jung-ah blames it on Mi-ho and looks into her past. Meanwhile, Mi-ho gives up on finding Yu-jin’s killer and returns to work. But feeling guilty, she decides to look after the kids and find the truth about Yu-jin’s death. One day, she receives an anonymous text about the USB.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Mi-ho fails to find the USB and to meet the one who sent the text. But she finds Jung-ah’s lipstick on the floor and becomes suspicious. One day, Mi-ho coincidentally finds the USB and discovers the "Pandora’s Box" folder inside. Meanwhile, Na-young sees Tae-ho and A-ra having an affair and decides to seek revenge. Right then, someone sends an anonymous letter to the bank, exposing Mi-ho’s past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Mi-ho finds out that the malicious social media post about her past was Jung-ah’s work and that Chang-hyun was at the apartment when Yu-jin was killed. Mi-ho thinks Jung-ah might have hired Chang-hyun to kill Yu-jin. But after Na-young tells Mi-ho that it wasn’t Jung-ah, Mi-ho is back at square one. Right then, the detectives barge in to investigate Mi-ho for attempted murder of Do-jun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Do-jun claims that Yu-jin and Mi-ho colluded to kill him and Mi-ho is questioned by the police. Mi-ho learns from the kindergarten teacher that Yu-jin took all of Ji-yul’s drawings before she was killed, and it bothers her. While looking through anonymous posts on the moms’ club, she is shocked to see a post about a woman who thinks her child saw a strange video on her husband’s laptop.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Mi-ho is certain that the anonymous post was written by Yu-jin. She unlocks the USB with a professional’s help and finds Do-jun’s video in the "Pandora’s Box". She confronts Do-jun, but he claims that Yu-jin started to suffer from anxiety after meeting Mi-ho and committed suicide. In front of Yu-jin’s house, Mi-ho finds a package addressed to Yu-jin with a note and a key.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Mi-ho goes to see Hye-jung to find out what the key is for. But Hye-jung is hostile to Mi-ho. After pressing Hye-jung, Mi-ho finds out the shocking truth about her mother and Yu-jin's father, and feels even guiltier towards Yu-jin. Meanwhile, Do-jun finds out that Mi-ho met Hye-jung and contacts ‘...’ on his phone. Finally, Mi-ho finds out that the key is for the resident locker in the apartment.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Mi-ho finds a ripped piece of a drawing in the locker and discovers someone took the package on the day of the incident. She then concludes that Ji-ye was the one who left the package. She confronts Ji-ye, but Ji-ye only admits to looking for the USB and says she thinks Su-bin left the package. Mi-ho confronts Su-bin, but he denies it looking frightenend, which leaves Mi-ho suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Mi-ho tries to ask Jung-sik about the relationship between Su-bin and Yu-jin, but Jung-ah shows up and stops him. Later, Jung-ah tells Mi-ho about the heavy loan Ji-ye took out to buy a house and that Ji-ye has a motive. Mi-ho decides to follow Su-bin and Ji-ye and finds out that Ji-ye was at Yu-jin’s house on the night of the murder. Meanwhile, Ji-yul tells Mi-ho that she has an older sister.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: While Mi-ho is headed for Marilyn to meet Ju-a, Yu-jin’s secret daughter, Jin-seop is attacked by Ju-a who thinks Mi-ho is her birth mom. Ju-a is shocked to hear Yu-jin is dead and that Do-jun is her husband. Mi-ho is certain something happened between Ju-a and Do-jun and that it led Do-jun and Yu-jin to fight. Meanwhile, when Ji-ye tries to flee after scamming people, Mi-ho catches her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Ji-ye clams up upon Do-jun’s threat. Mi-ho and Do-jun are out to find the black USB before one another. While trying to replay what happened the night Yu-jin died, Mi-ho realizes where the USB might be and finally finds it. The USB contains audio files of Yu-jin hiring a hitman on Do-jun and him doing the same. Mi-ho is sure that Do-jun is the killer, and he kidnaps and takes her to his clinic.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Do-jun tries to kill Mi-ho. She gets away from him but gets caught and dragged up to the rooftop. Just when he’s about to throw her off the roof, Jin-seop, Jung-ah and Na-young save her. Mi-ho hears the news of her promotion and new post in an overseas branch. She reads the last part of Yu-jin’s complaint letter and lets go of her grudge. She decides to start a new life with Ji-yul and Ha-yul.

Entries.Title: Payback: Money and Power
Entries.Description: Eun Yong has led a rough life since losing his parents at a young age. His goal is to live a happy life with his sister Ji-hee and her son Tae-chun. After making a great fortune and living in Mongolia free from worldly cares, Eun returns to Korea to protect the ones he loves.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Eun Yong has led a rough life since losing his parents at a young age. His goal is to live a happy life with his sister Ji-hee and her son Tae-chun. After making a great fortune and living in Mongolia free from worldly cares, Eun returns to Korea to protect the ones he loves.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: CEO Yoon was a ray of light to Eun Yong, who had been living his life in darkness. She and her daughter Joon-gyeong were his second family to him. Eun has doubts about Yoon's death when he realizes that something isn't right.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: After 10 years, Joon-gyeong and Eun Yong finally re-connect. Eun Yong hears from Joon-gyeong the real story behind CEO Yoon's death. Special Investigations prosecutor Gi-seok makes Tae-chun an offer that he can't refuse.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Eun Yong's strategy to bring down Chairman Myung has begun, while Joon-gyeong and Tae-chun plan on turning the situation on its head in their own ways. Eventually, Chairman Myung and Gi-seok retaliate with their own powerful counterattacks.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Eun Yong barely survives a life-threatening crisis. He calls on Joon-gyeong and Tae-chun to devise a new strategy. The situation takes a new turn when Joon-gyeong speaks at a press conference.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Eun Yong turn himself in, to be the bait. However, because of Chairman Myung's scheme, he is suddenly accused of murder. Tae-chun desperately asks Joon-gyeong for help to save Eun Yong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Crisis is another opportunity. Eun Yong sharpens his sword of revenge while in prison. Joon-gyeong wakes up from coma, and Tae-chun is constantly on the move to find leads on his own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Eun Yong offers Gi-seok a deal. As a result, Tae-chun returns to Prosecution Service once his suspension ends. While pretending to lower their heads, Eun Yong and Tae-chun bide time for another counterattack. Meanwhile, Joon-gyeong begins to plot her own cold revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Eun Yong feels defeated by Chairman Myung's unexpected counterattack. However, he calmly prepares for an opportunity to strike back at Chairman Myung and Gi-seok. Eun Yong sets a trap and waits for the perfect timing. Finally, the opportunity arrives to turn the tide of this war.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Eun Yong makes Se-hee a secret proposal to motivate Gi-seok, who then sees hope for his ambitions again. Is it money or is it power? Gi-seok finds himself at crossroads. In the end, the disgraced prosecutor makes his final decision.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Push comes to shove, and Gi-seok agrees to play along as Eun Yong's pawn, while gunning for his own comeback. Gi-seok's press conference related to Bawoo Fund succeeds in coinciding with his entire agenda. Corruption and justice swirl and collide, and a gunless war finally begins.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Giseok's endless greed runs rampant. Joon-gyeong, Tae-chun, and Eun Yong promise to fight against him to the end, but their different methods to deliver justice violently collide in the final battle. Finally, cartels of power and money begin to collapse.

Entries.Title: Woman in a Veil
Entries.Description: After tying the knot with Yu Jin, Gyeo Ul moved in with him and his family. However, despite being her first birthday since the wedding, nobody in the household appears to have remembered or acknowledged it. Pressured by her mother-in-law to start a family, Gyeo Ul chooses to stop taking her bronchial medication. Meanwhile, Se Rin reunites with Tae Yang after a three-year absence, but he doesn't seem pleased to see her again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After tying the knot with Yu Jin, Gyeo Ul moved in with him and his family. However, despite being her first birthday since the wedding, nobody in the household appears to have remembered or acknowledged it. Pressured by her mother-in-law to start a family, Gyeo Ul chooses to stop taking her bronchial medication. Meanwhile, Se Rin reunites with Tae Yang after a three-year absence, but he doesn't seem pleased to see her again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Gyeo Ul is looking forward to her upcoming trip to a resort with Yu Jin, but she is unaware that Ae Ra, who she trusts the most, and is Yu Jin's mistress, will also be there. Tae Yang is unable to forgive himself for hurting someone and is experiencing great emotional pain because of it. Se Rin makes a foolish decision to help Tae Yang, but it leads to unforeseen condequences.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Young Ran has been robbed by a pickpocket at the department store, and she suspects Tae Yang. When she finds out that Tae Yang has a criminal record, her suspicion turns into conviction. However, Gyeo Ul tries to clear up the misunderstanding which makes Young Ran take her anger out on her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Even though Hyun Tae forgives Yu Jin, he treats Gyeo Ul even more disrespectfully as soon as they leave his place. Se Rin blows up when Se Yeon sets her up on a blind date, and Se Yeon asks Tae Yang to move out of their house. Meanwhile, Ae Ra plots a scheme to sabotage Gyeo Ul to put out the affection Man Joong has for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Gyeo Ul investigates the earring and discovers that Yu Jin was its purchaser. Although Yu Jin and Ae Ra's deceitful explanations almost convince her, Gyeo Ul overhears something about Ae Ra's weekend activities that makes her suspicious. Meanwhile, Tae Yang informs his family of his desire to return to the sea, prompting Se Rin to initially react strongly but quickly compose herself and enact her backup plan to prevent Tae Yang from leaving.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Se Rin's blind date turns into a mess when Tae Yang takes the beating from her date while protecting her. Meanwhile, Ae Ra is consumed with worry that Gyeo Ul may acquire access to the corridor surveillance footage in the resort. As anticipated, Ae Ra doesn't think twice before putting Gyeo Ul to sleep in order to dispel her doubts with what she thinks is a foolproof scheme.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Se Rin finds out that she and Tae Yang have been deceived. In fact, Tae Yang has nothing to do with the murder charge he's been sentenced with. Se Rin right away looks deeper into the case, hoping to find evidence to prove Tae Yang's innocence. Meanwhile, the car accident was critical enough to take away Gyeo Ul's sight. On top of that, she needs to make a life-changing decision that involves tradeoffs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Yu Jin shows up at the hospital late after Gyeo Ul gives birth to their daughter. As Hyun Tae witnesses Yu Jin and Ae Ra together in front of the hospital, he can't shake off his concern for Gyeo Ul. Meanwhile, Se Yeon digs into the accident five years ago and finds out there was a real culprit who framed Tae Yang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Yu Jin kneels down in front of Hyun Tae and begs for forgiveness, which disappoints both Hyun Tae and Ae Ra. Hyun Tae visits Gyeo Ul the next day with a heavy heart, and Yu Jin's nerves are on the edge. Meanwhile, Se Yeon gets the actual name of Jang Mi through a detective agency and wants to meet her in person.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: When Se Yeon visits her with a barrage of questions, Ae Ra lies to escape a difficult situation. Se Rin, frustrated at not being able to clear Tae Yang's name, take it out on Se Yeon, leading to an argument. Meanwhile, Hyun Tae suspects an affair and follows Yu Jin, only to discover something strange about Gyeo Ul's bronchial medicine.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: After their misdeeds are revealed, Yu Jin and Ae Ra are in a difficult situation. They convince Hyun Tae that they can expedite Gyeo Ul's corneal transplant schedule to prevent him from exposing their secrets. Although hesitant at first, Hyun Tae ultimately agrees with their plan. Meanwhile, Se Yeon delves deeper into Ae Ra's background and takes a step that goes too far.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra covertly places what seems like a murder weapon inside Hyun Tae's car, which leads to his eventual arrest for murder. But just as she believes that the situation is under control, Ae Ra becomes the victim of blackmail by someone from her past who has a grudge against her. At the same time, Se Rin discovers Se Yeon's past and feels remorseful for how she has treated her lately.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Hyun Tae asks Yu Jin to come clean about his affair with Ae Ra to the police to defend himself from the false accusation of murder. Furthermore, Young Jun is searching everywhere for the organ trafficker, so Yu Jin and Ae Ra have to come up with another lie. Meanwhile, Se Rin gets infuriated at Se Yeon's funeral and is determined to take revenge for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: After her recent failure to seek revenge, Se Rin becomes even more determined to take extreme measures to achieve it. However, Tae Yang tries to prevent her from making impulsive decisions. Meanwhile, Hyun Tae is being held in solitary confinement by a corrupt officer at the detention center, and Ae Ra seeks alternative methods to make her family give up on Gyeo Ul.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra plans to convince Gyeo Ul to visit her imprisoned father secretly, intending to separate her from her daughter So Yi and isolate her from the family. Gyeo Ul later discovers her daughter is missing and cannot find her. Meanwhile, Se Rin's uncontrolled rage leads her to inflict more pain on Hyun Tae's family than she herself is experiencing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Gyeo Ul cannot deny the fact that she lost So Yi because of her. Not realizing how Ae Ra is behind the mess, Gyeo Ul decides that it would be better for her to stay at her parents' house until she finds So Yi. As Se Rin pursues her vendetta, Gyeo Ul becomes her next target. Later, an anonymous caller informs Gyeo Ul about a dashcam video that captures the woman who took So Yi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Hyun Tae gets infuriated as he finds out it was Yu Jin and Ae Ra who stopped him from making calls and getting visitors, not Se Rin. Since he has no chance of getting in tough with anyone, he decides to break out of jail.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Hyun Tae collapses and is transferred to a public hospital as he did not take his pills. Meanwhile, Gyeo Ul and Young Jun try to sort things out while their father is hospitalized. Gyeo Ul tries to find out if the camera footage she saw at the resort is manipulated or not. Young Jun gets a lead on the organ trafficker who can confirm Hyun Tae's alibi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Upon learning about Gyeo Ul's cornea transplant operation, Ae Ra formulates a scheme to deliberately sabotage it. When the surgery is unsuccessful, Ae Ra and Yu Jin openly ridicule Gyeo Ul, believing that as a blind person, she is powerless to retaliate. Despite facing opposition from all sides, Gyeo Ul remains steadfast in her resolve to hold Ae Ra and Yu Jin accountable for their actions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra wasn't sure if Gyeo Ul has regained her sight back or not, but she eventually figures it out. Now that she knows, she takes other measures to keep her quiet. While doing so, Ae Ra also finds out that she has something that doesn't belong to her and turns to even more extreme measures. Meanwhile, Se Rin realizes that Tae Yang was being honest when he said he wanted to go aboard with her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: After a miraculous event, Gyeo Ul finds herself in Se Rin's body due to a body switch. Now that five years have passed, Gyeo Ul is determined to take action to set things right. Meanwhile, despite Ae Ra's efforts, Yu Jin's family refuses to accept her as part of the family as long as Gyeo Ul has a chance of recovering from her vegetative state.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Se Rin learns that the USB hidden five years ago before the accident is in Tae Yang's bag. She decides to move into Jung Hye's house and live with them. Meanwhile, Yu Jin and Ae Ra plan to get divorce papers signed and stamped by threatening Gil Ja while Man Joong is away.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Gil Ja is about to sign the divorce papers for Yu Jin, but Young Jun gets released and has his charges dropped. Mal Ja tells everything about Yu Jin and Ae Ra to Man Joong. To get out of this trouble and to have him take herself in, Ae Ra takes on a difficult task at the company. However, if she manages to pull though, there might be hope for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra's loss of a crucial photo jeopardizes her contract deal with VN Group and her manager position. Adding to her woes, she is transferred to a branch store and has a challenging day dealing with an unhappy customer. Meanwhile, Se Rin keeps tabs on Ae Ra for revenge, and Tae Yang searches for the deceased manager's family and Jang Mi to clear his name.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: With Se Rin's assistance, Ae Ra is able to effectively close the deal with Chairman Pham and regain her position on the team. However, Se Rin intends to exploit Ae Ra's fabricated educational background to manipulate her. Meanwhile, Tae Yang is taking multiple measures to locate Jang Mi, but so far, he hasn't been able to find any leads on her whereabouts

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Tae Yang finally gets a chance to inquire about the crucial missing security footage that could prove his innocence, but Ae Ra claims she has no knowledge of it or of Se Yeon. Meanwhile, Se Rin brings to light a rumour suggesting that Ae Ra may have fabricated her educational background.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Se Rin sees Tae Yang meet with Ae Ra. She finds their relationship suspicious and plans to get Tae Yang to join the YJ Group to stir things up. Meanwhile, Tae Yang saves Ji Seok in crisis while picking up Ha Neul at the welfare center and gets invited to Man Joong's house. Ae Ra sees Tae Yang at Man Joong's place and feels threatened.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra tries to take Tae Yang apart from Man Joong by making him look like a thief. However, that plan does not fall through. On top of that, Se Rin secretly puts in an application for Tae Yang as a new recruit of YJ Group. If he gets the job and starts working with Ae Ra, he and Yu Jin might find out about each other's identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra's involvement in revealing Tae Yang's criminal records to the public is aimed at hindering his job prospects, but Man Joong's decision ensures that Tae Yang can successfully go through the hiring procedures. Meanwhile, Se Rin devises a plan to create a rift between Yu Jin and Ae Ra, intending to utilize an upcoming investment meeting.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Se Rin eventually makes Yu Jin realize how Ae Ra has been lying to him all this time, and this triggers his interest in Se Rin to grow. Feeling the necessity for something more impactful, Se Rin plans to present a clear proof that explains Ae Ra's deceitfulness. Meanwhile, Young Jun finds the thugs that Gyeo Ul was running away from.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Yu Jin sees Ae Ra and Tae Yang together and takes it the wrong way. Ae Ra tries to mend her relationship with Yu Jin and attempts to win a contract with Gold Resort. Meanwhile, Se Rin notices the gap between Ae Ra and Yu Jin's relationship and sees her chance to seduce Yu Jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Yu Jin slowly begins to fall for Se Rin's charms. However, he can't break up with Ae Ra since she got him recognized through the Gold Resort deal. Meanwhile, Young Jun is determined to find evidence of Yu Jin and Ae Ra's involvement in Gyeo Ul's accident by joining the YJ Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: After waking up in Se Rin's room, Yu Jin can't keep his mind off her. He looks for a way to break up with Ae Ra so that he can continue to see Se Rin. Meanwhile, Ae Ra finds it suspicious that Young Jun started working at the company and plans to get rid of him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Young Jun is perplexed by Se Rin's eagerness to assist him in clearing his name of sexual harassment allegations and making amends for the past. Meanwhile, Se Rin devises a plan to get back at Ae Ra, who colluded with Manager Mo to accuse Young Jun of sexual harassment. To compound Ae Ra's troubles, Se Rin creates the impression that Yu Jin is concealing something from her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Se Rin's scheming unfolds smoothly, causing Ae Ra to suspect that Yu Jin is romantically involved with Manager Mo. This prompts Ae Ra to track Yu Jin's phone in an attempt to uncover evidence of their supposed secret affair. At the same time, Yu Jin grows increasingly irritated by the close relationship between Tae Yang and Se Rin, and seeks ways to distance Tae Yang from Se Rin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: Se Rin almost gets found by Ae Ra, who was tracking Yu Jin's phone. However, Se Rin manages to escape the crisis with Yu Jin's help. After learning about Se Rin and Yu Jin's relationship, Tae Yang tries to stop Se Rin, but she doesn't listen. Meanwhile, Ae Ra grills Yu Jin about seeing another woman, but gets caught by Young Ran, who scolds her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: After learning Ae Ra's secret, Se Rin pushes Ae Ra to break up with Yu Jin, and Ae Ra struggles to find a way out of Se Rin and bar owner's threat. Meanwhile, Se Rin plans a on moving out of Jung Hye's house before Ae Ra learns about her relationship with Se Yeon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: Although Ae Ra learns something about the bar owner and uses it to escape his blackmail, she can't find anything on Se Rin. She decides to get rid of Se Rin instead. Meanwhile, Tae Yang realises he likes Se Rin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Se Rin's attempt to elicit a confession from Ae Ra falls apart when Tae yang becomes involved. As Ae Ra becomes aware of Se Rin's intention to reveal everything to Yu Jin, she pleads for another opportunity to make amends. Meanwhile, Tae Yang's perception of Se Rin undergoes a change, and he opens up about his feeling for her. However, Ae Ra realises this and uses it to her advantage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: Having recently experienced a major life crisis, Yu Jin finds himself unable to think clearly and instead relies on Ae Ra's assistance. However, as anticipated, Ae Ra's support comes at a cost. In this case, Yu Jin's commitment to Ae Ra becomes the price to pay. Meanwhile, Ae Ra seizes this opportunity to undermine Yu Jin and Se Rin's relationship. Se Rin becomes suspicious of Yu Jin's recent behaviour of avoiding her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: Se Rin becomes aware of Ae Ra's actions, and Yu Jin continues to feel guilty for something he didn't do.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: Young Jun becomes suspicious of Se Rin after hearing her call Gill Ja "Mom" and seeing her visit her in the hospital. YJ Group gets thrown into chaos over leaked documents by Yu Ri concerning a patent that has Young Jun scrambling to resolve. Meanwhile, Ae Ra takes advantage of the situation to win over Young Ran's heart.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Se Rin thinks Ae Ra could've been the one who attempted to kill Gyeo UI and starts to look for evidence. Ae Ra finds out about Se Rin's attempt to find evidence and tries to stop her. Meanwhile, Ae Ra suspects a connection between Se Rin and Gyeo UI

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra decides to falsely implicate Se Rin as the assailant in Gyeo UI's attempted murder, with the intention of probing the true extent of Se Rin and Gyeo UI's relationship. Meanwhile, Young Jun finds it peculiar to observe Ae Ra standing at a distance, watching Se Rin talk with the police, Furthermore, Se Rin's actions consistently evoke old memories of Gyeo UI within Young Jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: Consumed by the lingering presence of Gyeo UI that he senses through Se Rin, Young Jun becomes fixated on them. Upon discovering that a business associate has a close connection to Se Rin, He decides to test Se Rin, Meanwhile, Ae Ra shows no hesitation in endangering Man Joong's life for her own personal gain.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: Young Jun experiences a sense of relief as he finally unravels the truth behind the situation involving Se Rin and Gyeo UI. They seize the opportunity to reconnect and engage in meaningful conversation. In parallel, they deliberate on appropriate consequences to be meted out to Ae Ra and Yu Jin. Meanwhile, Ae Ra finds herself on the brink of an overseas transfer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 47
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra brings in a child impersonating So Yi, Claiming she found Man Joong's lost granddaughter, To show his appreciation, Man Joong cancel Ae Ra's appointment overseas, And Ae Ra gets reinstated to her old position, Meanwhile, Se Rin is thrilled to hear So Yi got found. But as So Yi's mother, Se Rin is heartbroken when she sees So Yi yearning for Ae Ra and can't do anything about it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 48
Episodes.Description: Kyung Sook, The woman who kidnapped So Yi, Enters Man Joon's house and blackmails Ae Ra after figuring out the little girl that Ae Ra brought isn't So Yi. Se Rin goes to Man Joon's place with Young Jun to see So Yi, But she witnesses Ha Neul getting blamed for something the fake So Yi did, And sadly can't take Ha Neul's side. Meanwhile, Ae Ra does her best to find the real So Yi, By meeting Kyung Sook's demands.

Episodes.Title: Episode 49
Episodes.Description: Se Rin discovers a picture from her old phone, showing Kyung Sook kidnapping So Yi. Without hesitation, she and Young Jun rush to Mr Nam's house. Yu Jin becomes annoyed with Se Rin always being with Young Jun whenever she visits his house. Meanwhile, Man Joong realises that Ha Neul was not the one who broke the pottery when he sees the fake So Yi claiming the doll as hers, not Ha Neul's.

Episodes.Title: Episode 50
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra introduced a child, claiming she was the long-lost So Yi from five years ago. Unfortunately, it was revealed that she was an imposter. The shocking news left Yu Jin and his family stunned, leading to Ae Ra immediately being asked to leave the house. Meanwhile, Se Rin prepared Kimchi rice soup for Gil Ja, who was devastated by the false So Yi revelation, while simultaneously grappling with the search for the real So Yi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 51
Episodes.Description: As Ae Ra intercedes, Se Rin's attempts to locate Kyung Sook are thwarted. leading to an unsuccessful outcome.

Episodes.Title: Episode 52
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra plots a car accident, and pretends to save Yu Jin by risking her life. She makes everyone believe she lost her memories, and Yu Jin wants to take responsibility for her. However, Se Rin does not fall for her sly trick, and comes up with a way to test her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 53
Episodes.Description: Man Joong has no choice and approves of Ae Ra and Yu Jin's marriage. He visits Gyeo UI in hospital to say a few words. Young Ran strongly opposes Man Joong's decision to ask Gil Ja for help. Meanwhile, Se Rin confirms that Ae Ra has been faking her Amnesia from the hospital's nurse and plans to expose the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 54
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra's ongoing charade of memory loss becomes  tiresome for Se Rin, leading her to decide on a more direct confrontation. Concurrently Ae Ra hatches a scheme to jeopardise Se Rin's job within the company. Sensing the urgency of Se Rin's current troubles, Tae Yang mobilises himself to find a solution. Ae Ra experiences a foreboding sensation upon realising that Ha Neul and So Yi are one and the same.

Episodes.Title: Episode 55
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra's primary objective is to ensure Ha Neul's departure to a foreign country, while Se Rin and Tae Yang, along with Tae Yang's family, make dedicated efforts to locate her. Suspicious of Ae Ra's involvement in the kidnapping, Se Rin tirelessly searches for evidence. Later, Tae Yang receives a text message from Se Rin, and softly invites her on a date.

Episodes.Title: Episode 56
Episodes.Description: Upon realising that So Yi has been beside her all along,  Se Rin is filled with remorse for not recognising her sooner. She becomes completely dedicated for being there for So Yi, prioritising her above everything else. Furthermore, observing her daughter's joy around Tae Yang triggers a transformation in Se Rin's attitude. Meanwhile, Ae Ra figures out that Se Rin and Tae Yang are living under the same roof.

Episodes.Title: Episode 57
Episodes.Description: Although Se Rin tell Yu Jin that Ae Ra was the one who ordered the kidnapping of So Yi, Yu Jin doesn't believe her now that he knows Se Rin is Se Yeon's sister. He even kicks her out of the company. Meanwhile, Ae Ra gets threatened by Kyung Sook when her engagement ceremony is just around the corner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 58
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra lures Yu Jin to make a deal with hotel WIN so she can start her revenge against YJ Group. Tae Yang convinces Jung Hye to approve of his and Se Rin's relationship after he finds out Jung Hye knows about them. Meanwhile, a man from Ae Ra's past appears, as she prepares for her revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 59
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra concludes that sending her uncle to jail is a vital step to eliminate any loose ends in her ultimate plan. In the meantime, Yu Jin successfully fulfills Ae Ra's intention by securing a loan from Pandora investment. At the same time, Tae Yang's doubts about Se Rin's drastic personality change since her return from studying abroad continue to grow, leading him to feel the need to test her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 60
Episodes.Description: Tae Yang discovers that the souls of Se Rin and Gyeo UI have been swapped, but what breaks his heart even more is the realisation that he has been decieved from the begining. He confronts Gyeo UI, who is in Se Rin's body, demanding an explanation for playing with his emotions. However, Gyeo UI refuses to reveal the truth to spare him further pain. Meanwhile, Yu Jin grows increasingly worried about the slow advancement of his contract with WIN Hotel.

Episodes.Title: Episode 61
Episodes.Description: Se Rin inquires with Tae Yang about the whereabouts of the flash drive copy containing footage of Ju Ae Ra's crime. However, Tae Yang is unaware of its existence. Meanwhile, Ae Ra accidently overhears a conversation between Young Jun and Tae Yang while searching for Yu Ri, and discovers that Gyeo UI created a copy of the flash drive and concealed it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 62
Episodes.Description: Se Rin pressure Ae Ra and Yu Jin with the voice recording. Ae Ra, in response attempts to take it from her but fails. To her horror, Tae Yang is already on his way to the police station witht he voice recording.

Episodes.Title: Episode 63
Episodes.Description: With the help of Lee Duk Bae, Ae Ra successfully manages to get her hands on the flash drive containing the voice recording. Yu Jin learns that the contract with WIN Hotel has failed, and Pandora insists on repayment as stated in the contract. Young Jun also becomes aware of this news.

Episodes.Title: Episode 64
Episodes.Description: With no support during his financial crisis,  Yu Jin receives a risky offer from Pandora. Meanwhile, Se Rin and Tae Yang assist Gyeo UI in regaining her lost memories after waking up from unconciousness. Recognising Gyeo UI as a potential obsticle, Ae Ra devises a plan to eliminate her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 65
Episodes.Description: Se Rin, Tae Yang, and Young Jun are on the lookout for Gyeo UI, who has been kidnapped once more.

Episodes.Title: Episode 66
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra is frustrated that she can't get her hands on Yu Jin's shares  of YJ Group because of Young Jun. In response, she plans to oust Young Jun from the company. Se Rin and Tae Yang search for a solution to assist Young Jun. Meanwhile Gyeo UI begins to recall memories of Tae Yang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 67
Episodes.Description: After seeing Young Jun get in troule because of Ae Ra, Se Rin concludes she must return to YJ Group. She plans to prevent Ae Ra's attempt to dispose of  surplus goods. Meanwhile, Gyeo UI regains more memories. Upon learning this, Se Rin arranges for Gyeo UI to meet Jung Hye.

Episodes.Title: Episode 68
Episodes.Description: As Gyeo UI regains her memories, She remembers she is actually Se Rin. Ae Ra manipulates Gyeo UI out of fear she'll confess that her soul has switched with Se Rin. Meanwhile, Gyeo UI learns of the relationship between Tae Yang and Se Rin, and demands they break up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 69
Episodes.Description: After their breakup, Tae Yang believed he could move on from Se Rin, only to find the pain much more excruciating than anticipated. Gyeo UI remains determined to confirm the end of their relationship before fulfilling her promise to Se Rin.  Meanwhile, Ae Ra, aware of the potential suspicion she would receive from Se Rin and Tae Yang's breakup, devises another plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 70
Episodes.Description: Although Tae Yang verbalises his lack of affection for Gyeo UI in Se Rin's body, it becomes srikingly clear that he has not completely gotten over her. The knowledge of this profoundly wounds Se Rin, who is currently occupying Gyeo UI's body. In the meantime, Ae Ra discovers a picture that could serve as a test to reveal Tae Yang's true emotions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 71
Episodes.Description: Upon discovering Tae Yang's feelings for Se Rin, Gyeo UI become enraged. She believes that Se Rin has taken everything from her and decides to seek revenge by targetting Se Rin's beloved family. Ae Ra expresses her willingness to assist Gyeo UI in her plans.

Episodes.Title: Episode 72
Episodes.Description: Young Jun reveals to Gil Ja that Se Rin and Gyeo UI's souls have switched. Gil Ja initially finds it hard to believe but gradually feels unsettled around Gyeo UI. Meanwhile, Ae Ra assists Gyeo UI in harassing Se Rin while carrying out her revenge against the honorary chairman, Man Joong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 73
Episodes.Description: Gil Ja and Jung Hye now believe Se Rin's soul has switched. Se Rin attempts to convince Gyeo UI to expose the truth behind Ae Ra and Yu Jin's crimes, but Gyeo UI refuses to listen. However, Gyeo UI eventually learns Ae Ra could be Jang Mi, the person Se Yeon had been desperately searching for.

Episodes.Title: Episode 74
Episodes.Description: Se Rin, who occupies Gyeo UI's body, plans to use the shared DNA with Ha Neul for her benefit, by invloving Ha Neul, she insists on obtaining the CCTV footage. Meanwhile, Ae Ra grows suspicious that Man Joong may have uncovered her hidden secrets. On the playground, Ha Neul, aware of her biological mother, disappears after following someone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 75
Episodes.Description: Powerless to intervene when Gyeo Ui takes Ha Neul, Se Rin endeavors to find alternative ways to reunite with her. With Gil Ja's assistance, Ha Neul is secretly taken out to meet Se Rin. However, Gyeo UI becomes suspicious upon returning home to find nobody there. Meanwhile, Ae Ra tries to prevent Mang Joong from uncovering her hidden secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 76
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra understands that her entire accumulation will be in vain if Man Joong uncovers Hyung Jung's true identity, Hence, she takes proactive measures to eliminate anything that could hinder her plans. Meanwhile, Gyeo UI annoyed by witnessing Gil Ja and Ha Neul's pleasant time together, plans to take Ha Neul to a place where no one can find her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 77
Episodes.Description: Ha Neul gets transferred to the hospital, and the families of Gil Ja and Jung Hye rush to the hospital. Ha Neul requires a liver transplant due to Gyeo UI's negligence. Meanwhile, Ae Ra successfully brings down Yu Jin, but the investigation is not advancing as rapidly as she had anticipated.

Episodes.Title: Episode 78
Episodes.Description: In a desperate move to save Ha Neul, Se Rin reveals to Yu Jin that Ha Neul is actually So Yi, hoping to persuade him to donate his liver and save So Yi's life. Meanwhile, Gyeo UI must become the only potential donor to win over Tae Yang. So she seeks Ae Ra's help to prevent Yu Jin from donating his liver.

Episodes.Title: Episode 79
Episodes.Description: As it turns out, Yu Jin is ineligible to donate his liver for a transplant, causing Tae Yang to accept the proposition of marrying Gyeo UI and relocating to a place beyond Se Rin's discovery. Young Jun tactfully questions Se Rin about any possible reason behind Gyeo UI's abrupt change of mind and realises that there is an underlying matter at hand.

Episodes.Title: Episode 80
Episodes.Description: Man Joong's excitement of finding Hyun Jung was short-lived as Ae Ra managed to arrive a step ahead.

Episodes.Title: Episode 81
Episodes.Description: With the delay of Ha Neul's liver transplant surgery, everyone becomes more worried as they find themselves in a state of helplessness, having nothing to do but wait, Ae Ra is anxious about Hyun Jung's prolonged stay due to the newly discovered news about her sister. Meanwhile, a glimmer of good news emerges as Ha Neul may have the opportunity to receive a liver trasnplant from another donor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 82
Episodes.Description: Se Rin gets infuriated when she realises Ae Ra was the one who murdered Se Yeon, her sister. Se Rin decides to get revenge on her, and Gyeo UI joins hands with her to bring Ae Ra down. Therefore, Gyeo UI exposes Ae Ra's past on the anonymous bulletin board at her office.

Episodes.Title: Episode 83
Episodes.Description: Gyeo UI attempts to murder Ae Ra on a rooftop but fails, and Se Rin gets injured in the process. This incident causes Gyeo UI to have a change of heart. She decides to hand over the evidence footage to the police. Upon learning about Gyeo UI's plans, Ae Ra is determined to stop her at all costs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 84
Episodes.Description: Se Rin discloses to Yu Jin's family the unexpected revelation of her and Gyeo UI's souls being swapped, insisting that it is only right for her to raise Ha Neul. Meanwhile, Young Jun meets with a nurse who had cared for Hyun Tae, questioning her to find any information that can prove Hyun Tae had been murdered. Shortly after the meeting, the nurse makes a suspicious phone  call.

Episodes.Title: Episode 85
Episodes.Description: Se Rin believes that contacting the hospital director who was in charge during Hyun Tae's incident is the only way to uncover the truth. However, she repeatedly fails to do so. Meanwhile, Yeon Seok instructs  Sang Guk to prevent Se Rin from delving further into the matter. At the same time, Ae Ra begins to suspect that something is amiss after recalling Se Rin's comments about Hyun Tae's autopsy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 86
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra intentionally discloses to Man Joong the suspicions Se Rin and Young Jun have regarding Hyun Tae's death. With the intention of aiding them, Man Joong delves into the case and uncovers Secretary Pyeon's connection to it. Sensing a threat as they get closer to Secretary Pyeon, Yeon Seok decides to  send him abroad.

Episodes.Title: Episode 87
Episodes.Description: Sang Guk tries to leave the country before Gyeo UI catches her. However, he fails as she asks for help from Yeon Seok. Gyeo UI waits at the hospital where his elderly mother is to find him. Meanwhile, Yu Ri overhears Ae Ra talking on the phone with Alex, and Yu Jun digs into Sang Guk on his own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 88
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seok is furious about Sang Guk getting caught because he returned to the hospital for his real passport despite being provided a counterfeit one. Yeon Seok also learns that Sang Guk took the risk because of a voice recorder, so he decides to take action. Meanwhile, Man Joong receives a phone call before attending Ji Seok's ceremony.

Episodes.Title: Episode 89
Episodes.Description: Man Joong lies helplessly and unconscious on the floor at his house, all because of Yeon Seok. Luckily, Se Rin finds him and rushes him to the hospital, but he remains unconscious. Ae Ra successfully prevents Hyun Jung from meeting with Man Joong, but the details shared during their phone call continue to unsettle her. Meanwhile, a rumor about Man Joong's critical condition starts circulating in the financial district.

Episodes.Title: Episode 90
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra ends up in a tight spot and is forced to leave YJ after Yeon Seok discovers her hidden secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 91
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra has no choice but to resort to blackmailing Yeon Seok, armed with the evidence of his whereabouts during the collapse of Man Joong. Similarly, Yeon Seok is compelled to keep Ae Ra by his side. Meanwhile, Se Rin finds out that Yeon Seok has been frequenting the nearby areas while looking for evidence. As for Sang Guk, he thinks he is safe in his hideout, but he hears a familiar voice just outside his door.

Episodes.Title: Episode 92
Episodes.Description: Sang Guk reveals the truth behind Hyun Tae's death to Gyeo UI before turning himself in. Gyeo UI is shocked to find out the real culprit and decides to meet Sang Guk at the station to get more details. However, he does not show up as promised. Gyeo UI, Young Jun, and Tae Yang visit the clock shop where Sang Guk was hiding

Episodes.Title: Episode 93
Episodes.Description: Gyeo UI thinks Yeon Seok will have no choice but to admit to his crimes now that all the evidence has been exposed to the public. However, he strongly argues that he is innocent and manages to get released after the investigation. Therefore, Gyeo UI has to come up with another plan to bring him down. Meanwhile, Yeon Seok finds out there was an eavesdropping device in his study.

Episodes.Title: Episode 94
Episodes.Description: Upon realising that the unexpected vote result was orchestrated by Alex, Ae Ra faces Yeon Seok's unleashed frustration as he scolds her for letting him down. With rumors spreading about Director Park being a potential replacement for Yeon Seok, Ae Ra feels compelled to resort to her customary unethical tactics as a means of dealing with Director Park.

Episodes.Title: Episode 95
Episodes.Description: While Jung Hye is heading back to her store, she unexpectedly encounters a person who is the splitting image of Jung Wook. Despite her inquiries, he denies being the one she seeks. Disappointed, Jung Hye can't stop thinking about the encounter. Meanwhile, Tae Yang comes to the rescue of Director Park, who was almost held accountable for Ae Ra's unethical scheme. Ae Ra, in the meantime, manages to extricate herself by striking a deal with Yeon Seok.

Episodes.Title: Episode 96
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra suggests Yeon Seok run in the election and frame the shell company incident on the honorary chairman.

Episodes.Title: Episode 97
Episodes.Description: After witnessing Jung Hye with Tae Yang, Yeon Seok runs a DNA test between Tae Yang and Ji Seok. Ae Ra becomes furious when she discovers Yeon Seok has the footage of her moving Se Yeon's body. Meanwhile, Yeon Seok finds out that Jung Hye is joining Ha Neul and Ji Seok's picnic, prompting him to rush out to prevent them from meeting each other.

Episodes.Title: Episode 98
Episodes.Description: Jung Hye is surprised to meet Ji Seok again as Ha Neul's uncle. When she finds out he lost his memories from the accident, she asks Gyeo UI for more details about him. Meanwhile, Ji Seok recalls old memories of Jung Hye as well. Before the truth comes out, Yeon Seok tries to send Ji Seok abroad.

Episodes.Title: Episode 99
Episodes.Description: Upon discovering that Ji Seok is his biological father, Tae Yang wastes no time in filing for guardianship to take  care of him. While Tae Yang rejoices in this newfound connection, Ae Ra believes Ji Seok is accountable for her mother's passing, making it unbearable to witness Ji Seok's happiness with Tae Yang. In desperation, she proposes to Yeon Seok that they eliminate Tae Yang as their final option.

Episodes.Title: Episode 100
Episodes.Description: As Man Joong regains consciousness, Yeon Seok's connection to the shell company is exposed, leaving him with nowhere to seek help. Ae Ra proposes that Yeon Seok strike a bargain with Man Joong, leveraging a crucial video that could vindicate Tae Yang's innocence. Meanwhile, Se Rin must locate Pyeon Sang Guk to uncover Yeon Seok's role in provoking a murder.

Episodes.Title: Episode 101
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seok and Ae Ra team up to take back Sang Guk from Se Rin. However, Se Rin is aware of their plan and intends to use it to get Yeon Seok's confession. Meanwhile, at Se Rin's request, Man Joong calls Ae Ra to his room and asks her to turn herself in.

Episodes.Title: Episode 102
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra wails in pain when she realises Gyeo UI is her sister. Ae Ra hopes Gyeo UI will never find out that she is her older sister after all the evil she has done to her. Meanwhile, Yeon Seok calls Ae Ra to ask for help so he can leave the country, and Ae Ra plans to take revenge on him when they meet.

Episodes.Title: Episode 103
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seok and Yu Jin are convicted for their crimes. Se Rin confronts Ae Ra, but she is uncertain about her emotiions. As the family faces turmoil, Man Joong invites everyone over for a big announcement. How will everyone respond to the recent developments?
